"""
Pipeline de Ingesta y Reconciliación: Indicadores Medidos por Nacionalidad en España.
Extrae estadísticas oficiales del INE remitidas a Eurostat (Padrón/ECP, EPA, ECV, Adquisiciones)
aplicando neutralidad estricta y trazabilidad directa, y genera ./staging/items/indicadores-nacionalidad-espana.json.
"""

import argparse
from datetime import date
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
from typing import Any, Optional

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from scrapers.eurostat_client import fetch_eurostat_dataset, EurostatDataset


GROUP_CODE_MAP = {
    "TOTAL": "total",
    "NAT": "nationals",
    "FOR": "foreigners",
    "FOR_STLS": "foreigners",
    "EU27_2020_FOR": "euForeigners",
    "NEU27_2020_FOR": "nonEuForeigners",
}


def load_json(path: Path) -> dict:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)


def validate_concept_guide(guide: dict) -> None:
    if not guide.get("title") or not isinstance(guide["title"], str):
        raise ValueError("conceptGuide.title must be a non-empty string.")
    categories = {c["id"] for c in guide.get("categories", [])}
    if not categories:
        raise ValueError("conceptGuide.categories must not be empty.")

    terms = guide.get("terms", [])
    if not terms or not isinstance(terms, list):
        raise ValueError("conceptGuide.terms must be a non-empty list.")

    seen_codes = set()
    for term in terms:
        code = term.get("code")
        if not code or code in seen_codes:
            raise ValueError(f"Código de concepto duplicado o inválido en guía: {code}")
        seen_codes.add(code)
        cat_id = term.get("categoryId")
        if cat_id not in categories:
            raise ValueError(f"Categoría inválida '{cat_id}' en término '{code}'")

    for term in terms:
        for rel in term.get("relatedCodes", []):
            if rel not in seen_codes:
                raise ValueError(f"relatedCode '{rel}' en término '{term.get('code')}' no existe en terms.")


def build_nationality_indicators_payload(
    config: dict,
    datasets: dict[str, EurostatDataset],
    guide: Optional[dict] = None,
) -> dict:
    """
    Transforma, pivota y valida los datasets de Eurostat para producir el contrato
    canónico de NationalityIndicatorsItem.
    """
    start_year = int(config.get("startYear", 2008))

    ds_pop_ctz = datasets.get("popByCitizenship")
    ds_pop_birth = datasets.get("popByBirth")
    ds_acq = datasets.get("naturalizations")
    ds_emp_ctz = datasets.get("employedByCitizenship")
    ds_emp_birth = datasets.get("employedByBirth")
    ds_act_ctz = datasets.get("activityRateByCitizenship")
    ds_act_birth = datasets.get("activityRateByBirth")
    ds_empr_ctz = datasets.get("employmentRateByCitizenship")
    ds_empr_birth = datasets.get("employmentRateByBirth")
    ds_unemp_ctz = datasets.get("unemploymentRateByCitizenship")
    ds_unemp_birth = datasets.get("unemploymentRateByBirth")
    ds_inc_ctz = datasets.get("incomeByCitizenship")
    ds_inc_tot = datasets.get("incomeTotal")
    ds_pov_ctz = datasets.get("povertyRateByCitizenship")
    ds_pov_tot = datasets.get("povertyRateTotal")

    if not ds_pop_ctz or not ds_pop_birth:
        raise ValueError("Los datasets demográficos básicos (popByCitizenship, popByBirth) son obligatorios.")

    # 1. Indexar población por (time, citizen/c_birth, age)
    # Para citizenship, priorizar FOR si existe, o FOR_STLS si FOR no está
    pop_ctz_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str, str], float] = {}
    for r in ds_pop_ctz.records:
        t = str(r.get("time"))
        c = r.get("citizen")
        a = r.get("age")
        v = r.get("value")
        if t and c and a and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
            pop_ctz_lookup[(t, c, a)] = float(v)

    pop_birth_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str, str], float] = {}
    for r in ds_pop_birth.records:
        t = str(r.get("time"))
        cb = r.get("c_birth")
        a = r.get("age")
        v = r.get("value")
        if t and cb and a and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
            pop_birth_lookup[(t, cb, a)] = float(v)

    # 2. Indexar adquisiciones por year
    acq_lookup: dict[str, int] = {}
    if ds_acq:
        for r in ds_acq.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                acq_lookup[t] = int(round(float(v)))

    # 3. Indexar mercado laboral (citizenship)
    # emp_ctz: (time, citizen) -> value (thousands)
    emp_ctz_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_emp_ctz:
        for r in ds_emp_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                emp_ctz_lookup[(t, c)] = float(v)

    act_ctz_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_act_ctz:
        for r in ds_act_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                act_ctz_lookup[(t, c)] = float(v)

    empr_ctz_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_empr_ctz:
        for r in ds_empr_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                empr_ctz_lookup[(t, c)] = float(v)

    unemp_ctz_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_unemp_ctz:
        for r in ds_unemp_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                unemp_ctz_lookup[(t, c)] = float(v)

    # 4. Indexar mercado laboral (birthplace)
    emp_birth_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_emp_birth:
        for r in ds_emp_birth.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            cb = r.get("c_birth")
            v = r.get("value")
            # If lfsa_pgacws, check wstatus == "EMP" if dimension present
            wstatus = r.get("wstatus")
            if wstatus and wstatus != "EMP":
                continue
            if t and cb and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                emp_birth_lookup[(t, cb)] = float(v)

    act_birth_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_act_birth:
        for r in ds_act_birth.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            cb = r.get("c_birth")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and cb and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                act_birth_lookup[(t, cb)] = float(v)

    empr_birth_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_empr_birth:
        for r in ds_empr_birth.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            cb = r.get("c_birth")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and cb and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                empr_birth_lookup[(t, cb)] = float(v)

    unemp_birth_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_unemp_birth:
        for r in ds_unemp_birth.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            cb = r.get("c_birth")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and cb and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                unemp_birth_lookup[(t, cb)] = float(v)

    # 5. Indexar renta y pobreza (ilc_di15, ilc_di03, ilc_li31, ilc_li02)
    # income: (time, citizen/group, metric) -> float
    # metric: "MED" or "MEAN"
    inc_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_inc_ctz:
        for r in ds_inc_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen") or r.get("c_citizen")
            stat = r.get("statinfo") or r.get("indic_il")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and stat and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                m_key = "MED" if "MED" in stat else "MEAN"
                inc_lookup[(t, c, m_key)] = float(v)

    if ds_inc_tot:
        for r in ds_inc_tot.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            stat = r.get("statinfo") or r.get("indic_il")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and stat and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                m_key = "MED" if "MED" in stat else "MEAN"
                inc_lookup[(t, "TOTAL", m_key)] = float(v)

    pov_lookup: dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}
    if ds_pov_ctz:
        for r in ds_pov_ctz.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            c = r.get("citizen") or r.get("c_citizen")
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and c and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                pov_lookup[(t, c)] = float(v)

    if ds_pov_tot:
        for r in ds_pov_tot.records:
            t = str(r.get("time"))
            v = r.get("value")
            if t and v is not None and math.isfinite(v):
                pov_lookup[(t, "TOTAL")] = float(v)

    # 6. Determinar años cronológicos válidos
    # Años >= start_year donde existan datos en popByCitizenship para TOTAL y NAT, y (FOR o FOR_STLS)
    all_years = set()
    for (t, c, a), _ in pop_ctz_lookup.items():
        try:
            y_int = int(t)
            if y_int >= start_year and a == "TOTAL":
                all_years.add(t)
        except ValueError:
            continue

    valid_years = []
    for y in sorted(all_years, key=int):
        has_total = (y, "TOTAL", "TOTAL") in pop_ctz_lookup
        has_nat = (y, "NAT", "TOTAL") in pop_ctz_lookup
        has_for = (y, "FOR", "TOTAL") in pop_ctz_lookup or (y, "FOR_STLS", "TOTAL") in pop_ctz_lookup
        if has_total and has_nat and has_for:
            valid_years.append(y)

    if len(valid_years) < 10:
        raise ValueError(f"Se encontraron solo {len(valid_years)} años válidos (mínimo 10 requeridos desde {start_year}).")

    annual_records = []
    top_level_datapoints = []

    def get_pop_stat(lookup: dict, y: str, code: str, age: str) -> Optional[float]:
        if (y, code, age) in lookup:
            return lookup[(y, code, age)]
        if code == "FOR" and (y, "FOR_STLS", age) in lookup:
            return lookup[(y, "FOR_STLS", age)]
        return None

    for y in valid_years:
        def_slices = {}

        for def_key, lookup, map_param in [
            ("citizenship", pop_ctz_lookup, "citizen"),
            ("birthplace", pop_birth_lookup, "c_birth"),
        ]:
            # Demographics
            total_pop = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, "TOTAL", "TOTAL")
            total_working_age = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, "TOTAL", "Y15-64")

            if total_pop is None or total_pop <= 0 or total_working_age is None or total_working_age <= 0:
                demo_block = None
            else:
                demo_block = {}
                target_groups = [
                    ("total", "TOTAL"),
                    ("nationals", "NAT"),
                    ("foreigners", "FOR"),
                    ("euForeigners", "EU27_2020_FOR"),
                    ("nonEuForeigners", "NEU27_2020_FOR"),
                ]

                for gkey, ecode in target_groups:
                    pop = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, ecode, "TOTAL")
                    u15 = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, ecode, "Y_LT15")
                    w15_64 = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, ecode, "Y15-64")
                    s65 = get_pop_stat(lookup, y, ecode, "Y_GE65")

                    if pop is not None and u15 is not None and w15_64 is not None and s65 is not None:
                        share_total = round((pop / total_pop) * 100.0, 2)
                        share_work = round((w15_64 / total_working_age) * 100.0, 2)
                        u15_pct = round((u15 / pop) * 100.0, 2) if pop > 0 else 0.0
                        w15_64_pct = round((w15_64 / pop) * 100.0, 2) if pop > 0 else 0.0
                        s65_pct = round((s65 / pop) * 100.0, 2) if pop > 0 else 0.0
                        dep_ratio = round((s65 / w15_64) * 100.0, 1) if w15_64 > 0 else 0.0

                        demo_block[gkey] = {
                            "population": int(round(pop)),
                            "shareOfTotalPct": share_total,
                            "shareOfWorkingAgePct": share_work,
                            "oldAgeDependencyRatio": dep_ratio,
                            "ageBands": {
                                "under15": int(round(u15)),
                                "workingAge15to64": int(round(w15_64)),
                                "senior65plus": int(round(s65)),
                                "under15Pct": u15_pct,
                                "workingAge15to64Pct": w15_64_pct,
                                "senior65plusPct": s65_pct,
                            },
                        }
                    elif gkey in ("total", "nationals", "foreigners"):
                        # If primary groups are missing, mark demo_block as incomplete
                        demo_block = None
                        break

            # Labor Market
            if def_key == "citizenship":
                emp_lk = emp_ctz_lookup
                act_lk = act_ctz_lookup
                empr_lk = empr_ctz_lookup
                unemp_lk = unemp_ctz_lookup
            else:
                emp_lk = emp_birth_lookup
                act_lk = act_birth_lookup
                empr_lk = empr_birth_lookup
                unemp_lk = unemp_birth_lookup

            total_emp = emp_lk.get((y, "TOTAL"))
            has_any_labor = any(
                (y, code) in lk
                for lk in (emp_lk, act_lk, empr_lk, unemp_lk)
                for code in ("TOTAL", "NAT", "FOR")
            )

            if not has_any_labor:
                labor_block = None
            else:
                labor_block = {}
                target_labor_groups = [
                    ("total", "TOTAL"),
                    ("nationals", "NAT"),
                    ("foreigners", "FOR"),
                    ("euForeigners", "EU27_2020_FOR"),
                    ("nonEuForeigners", "NEU27_2020_FOR"),
                ]
                for gkey, ecode in target_labor_groups:
                    emp_val = emp_lk.get((y, ecode))
                    act_val = act_lk.get((y, ecode))
                    empr_val = empr_lk.get((y, ecode))
                    unemp_val = unemp_lk.get((y, ecode))

                    share_emp = None
                    if emp_val is not None and total_emp is not None and total_emp > 0:
                        share_emp = round((emp_val / total_emp) * 100.0, 2)

                    if any(v is not None for v in (emp_val, act_val, empr_val, unemp_val)):
                        labor_block[gkey] = {
                            "employedThousands": round(emp_val, 1) if emp_val is not None else None,
                            "shareOfEmployedPct": share_emp,
                            "activityRatePct": round(act_val, 1) if act_val is not None else None,
                            "employmentRatePct": round(empr_val, 1) if empr_val is not None else None,
                            "unemploymentRatePct": round(unemp_val, 1) if unemp_val is not None else None,
                        }

            def_slices[def_key] = {
                "demographics": demo_block,
                "laborMarket": labor_block,
            }

        # Living Conditions (citizenship)
        has_any_income = any(
            (y, code, m) in inc_lookup
            for code in ("TOTAL", "NAT", "FOR")
            for m in ("MED", "MEAN")
        ) or any((y, code) in pov_lookup for code in ("TOTAL", "NAT", "FOR"))

        if not has_any_income:
            living_block = None
        else:
            living_block = {}
            target_income_groups = [
                ("total", "TOTAL"),
                ("nationals", "NAT"),
                ("foreigners", "FOR"),
                ("euForeigners", "EU27_2020_FOR"),
                ("nonEuForeigners", "NEU27_2020_FOR"),
            ]
            for gkey, ecode in target_income_groups:
                med_inc = inc_lookup.get((y, ecode, "MED"))
                mean_inc = inc_lookup.get((y, ecode, "MEAN"))
                pov_pct = pov_lookup.get((y, ecode))

                if any(v is not None for v in (med_inc, mean_inc, pov_pct)):
                    living_block[gkey] = {
                        "medianEquivalisedIncomeEur": round(med_inc, 1) if med_inc is not None else None,
                        "meanEquivalisedIncomeEur": round(mean_inc, 1) if mean_inc is not None else None,
                        "atRiskOfPovertyPct": round(pov_pct, 1) if pov_pct is not None else None,
                    }

        # Naturalizations
        nat_val = acq_lookup.get(y)

        annual_records.append({
            "year": y,
            "naturalizations": nat_val,
            "definitions": def_slices,
            "livingConditions": living_block,
        })

        # Top-level dataPoints (foreigners share of total population by citizenship)
        cit_demo = def_slices["citizenship"]["demographics"]
        if cit_demo and "foreigners" in cit_demo:
            top_level_datapoints.append({
                "year": y,
                "value": cit_demo["foreigners"]["shareOfTotalPct"],
            })

    # Assertions de integridad antes de escribir
    if len(top_level_datapoints) < 10:
        raise ValueError(f"Se requieren al menos 10 dataPoints cronológicos (obtenidos {len(top_level_datapoints)}).")

    for rec in annual_records:
        y = rec["year"]
        for dkey in ["citizenship", "birthplace"]:
            demo = rec["definitions"][dkey]["demographics"]
            if demo:
                tot_p = demo["total"]["population"]
                nat_p = demo["nationals"]["population"]
                for_p = demo["foreigners"]["population"]
                # Tolerancia del 1% para apátridas / no clasificables en registros administrativos
                diff_pop = abs((nat_p + for_p) - tot_p) / tot_p
                if diff_pop > 0.01:
                    raise ValueError(f"Fallo en identidad demográfica {dkey} año {y}: (NAT + FOR) != TOTAL ({diff_pop * 100:.2f}% de error)")

                for grp_k in ["total", "nationals", "foreigners"]:
                    if grp_k in demo:
                        bands = demo[grp_k]["ageBands"]
                        sum_pct = bands["under15Pct"] + bands["workingAge15to64Pct"] + bands["senior65plusPct"]
                        if abs(sum_pct - 100.0) > 0.5:
                            raise ValueError(f"Suma de porcentajes etarios inválida ({sum_pct:.2f}%) en {dkey} {grp_k} año {y}")

            labor = rec["definitions"][dkey]["laborMarket"]
            if labor:
                for grp_k, lstats in labor.items():
                    for rate_key in ["activityRatePct", "employmentRatePct", "unemploymentRatePct"]:
                        r_val = lstats.get(rate_key)
                        if r_val is not None:
                            if not math.isfinite(r_val) or r_val < 0.0 or r_val > 100.0:
                                raise ValueError(f"Tasa laboral corrupta o fuera de rango [0, 100]: {rate_key}={r_val} en {dkey} {grp_k} {y}")

        liv = rec["livingConditions"]
        if liv:
            for grp_k, istats in liv.items():
                for inc_key in ["medianEquivalisedIncomeEur", "meanEquivalisedIncomeEur"]:
                    i_val = istats.get(inc_key)
                    if i_val is not None:
                        if not math.isfinite(i_val) or i_val <= 0:
                            raise ValueError(f"Renta corrupta o negativa: {inc_key}={i_val} en {grp_k} {y}")
                p_val = istats.get("atRiskOfPovertyPct")
                if p_val is not None:
                    if not math.isfinite(p_val) or p_val < 0.0 or p_val > 100.0:
                        raise ValueError(f"Tasa de pobreza fuera de rango [0, 100]: {p_val} en {grp_k} {y}")

    # Fuentes dinámicas
    output_sources = []
    all_updated = []
    for s in config.get("sources", []):
        s_keys = s.get("datasetKeys", [])
        updated_dates = [datasets[k].updated for k in s_keys if k in datasets and datasets[k].updated]
        all_updated.extend(updated_dates)
        last_upd = max(updated_dates, default=date.today().isoformat())
        output_sources.append({
            "institution": s["institution"],
            "shortName": s["shortName"],
            "title": s["title"],
            "tableId": s.get("tableId", ""),
            "period": f"{valid_years[0]}–{valid_years[-1]}",
            "lastUpdated": last_upd,
            "url": s["url"],
        })

    latest_global_update = max(all_updated, default=date.today().isoformat())

    payload = {
        "id": config["indicatorId"],
        "category": config["category"],
        "question": config["question"],
        "chartType": config["chartType"],
        "unit": config["headlineUnit"],
        "dataPoints": top_level_datapoints,
        "annualRecords": annual_records,
        "contextNotes": [
            "Todos los indicadores proceden directamente de estadísticas oficiales del INE remitidas a Eurostat (Padrón/ECP, EPA, ECV y Estadística de Adquisiciones de Nacionalidad), sin imputaciones sintéticas ni multiplicadores estimados.",
            "La clasificación por nacionalidad (pasaporte) refleja el estatus legal en cada año; las adquisiciones anuales de nacionalidad española trasladan a residentes nacidos en el extranjero del grupo de población extranjera al de nacionalidad española.",
            "Los indicadores del mercado laboral (tasa de actividad, empleo, paro y ocupados) corresponden a la población de 15 a 64 años conforme a los criterios armonizados de la EPA / LFS.",
            "La renta neta equivalente (ECV / EU-SILC) ajusta los ingresos disponibles del hogar por su tamaño y composición mediante la escala modificada de la OCDE para comparar el poder adquisitivo individual."
        ],
        "sources": output_sources,
        "last_updated": latest_global_update,
    }

    if guide:
        validate_concept_guide(guide)
        payload["conceptGuide"] = guide

    return payload


def run_pipeline(
    config_path: Path,
    guide_path: Optional[Path],
    output_path: Path,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> dict:
    config = load_json(config_path)
    guide = load_json(guide_path) if guide_path and guide_path.exists() else None

    base_url = config["apiBaseUrl"]
    datasets_cfg = config["datasets"]

    print(f"\n[1/3] 📥 Descargando datasets oficiales de Eurostat para {config['indicatorId']}...")
    datasets: dict[str, EurostatDataset] = {}

    for dkey, dinfo in datasets_cfg.items():
        code = dinfo["code"]
        params = dict(dinfo.get("params", {}))
        fallback_code = dinfo.get("fallbackCode")

        try:
            ds = fetch_eurostat_dataset(base_url, code, params, since_year=config.get("startYear", 2008))
            datasets[dkey] = ds
        except Exception as e:
            if fallback_code:
                print(f"      ⚠️ Query {code} falló ({e}). Intentando fallback {fallback_code}...")
                try:
                    ds = fetch_eurostat_dataset(base_url, fallback_code, params, since_year=config.get("startYear", 2008))
                    datasets[dkey] = ds
                    continue
                except Exception as e_fb:
                    print(f"      ❌ Fallback {fallback_code} también falló: {e_fb}")
            print(f"      ⚠️ Advertencia en dataset '{dkey}' ({code}): {e}")

    print("\n[2/3] ⚖️ Procesando, reconciliando y aplicando identidades estadísticas...")
    payload = build_nationality_indicators_payload(config, datasets, guide)

    years_count = len(payload["annualRecords"])
    first_y = payload["annualRecords"][0]["year"]
    last_y = payload["annualRecords"][-1]["year"]
    print(f"      ✓ Reconciliación exitosa para {years_count} años ({first_y}–{last_y}).")
    latest_pt = payload["dataPoints"][-1]
    print(f"      ✓ Último dato ({latest_pt['year']}): Población extranjera = {latest_pt['value']}% del total.")

    if dry_run:
        print("\n[3/3] 🔍 Modo --dry-run activado. Omitiendo escritura en disco.")
        print(f"      Muestra de registro {last_y}:")
        sample = payload["annualRecords"][-1]
        print(json.dumps({
            "year": sample["year"],
            "naturalizations": sample["naturalizations"],
            "citizenship_demo_foreigners": sample["definitions"]["citizenship"]["demographics"]["foreigners"],
            "citizenship_labor_foreigners": sample["definitions"]["citizenship"]["laborMarket"]["foreigners"] if sample["definitions"]["citizenship"]["laborMarket"] else None,
            "livingConditions_foreigners": sample["livingConditions"]["foreigners"] if sample["livingConditions"] else None,
        }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
        return payload

    print(f"\n[3/3] 💾 Escribiendo payload atómico en {output_path}...")
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp_fd, temp_file_path = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=str(output_path.parent), prefix="tmp_ind_nac_", suffix=".json")
    with os.fdopen(temp_fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(payload, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    os.replace(temp_file_path, output_path)
    print(f"      ✓ Archivo generado correctamente: {output_path} ({os.path.getsize(output_path):,} bytes)")

    return payload


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Pipeline de indicadores por nacionalidad (Factor.es)")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--config",
        type=Path,
        default=Path("scrapers/config/indicadores_nacionalidad_sources.json"),
        help="Ruta al archivo de fuentes Eurostat",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--guide",
        type=Path,
        default=Path("scrapers/config/indicadores_nacionalidad_guide.json"),
        help="Ruta a la guía conceptual",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        type=Path,
        default=Path("staging/items/indicadores-nacionalidad-espana.json"),
        help="Ruta de salida JSON en staging",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dry-run",
        action="store_true",
        help="Ejecuta la descarga y reconciliación sin escribir en disco",
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        run_pipeline(args.config, args.guide, args.output, dry_run=args.dry_run)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n❌ ERROR FATAL en pipeline de indicadores por nacionalidad: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

// FILE: scrapers/ine_client.py

"""
Cliente HTTP dedicado a consultar las tablas de la API oficial del INE.
Responsabilidad única (SRP): Comunicación e integración con la API Tempus JS del INE.
"""

import json
import requests
from tqdm import tqdm

INE_API_BASE_URL = "https://servicios.ine.es/wstempus/js/ES/DATOS_TABLA"


def fetch_ine_table(table_id: str, tip: str = "AM", timeout: int = 60) -> list:
    """
    Consulta la API Tempus del INE para obtener los datos crudos de una tabla determinada,
    mostrando una barra de progreso en tiempo real con tqdm.
    """
    url = f"{INE_API_BASE_URL}/{table_id}?tip={tip}"
    print(f"\n[1/4] 🌐 Descargando datos desde la API del INE (Tabla {table_id})...")

    with requests.get(url, stream=True, timeout=timeout) as response:
        response.raise_for_status()
        total_size = int(response.headers.get("content-length", 0))
        chunk_size = 16384
        chunks = []

        with tqdm(
            total=total_size if total_size > 0 else None,
            unit="B",
            unit_scale=True,
            unit_divisor=1024,
            desc="      Descarga INE",
            ncols=80,
        ) as pbar:
            for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=chunk_size):
                if chunk:
                    chunks.append(chunk)
                    pbar.update(len(chunk))

        raw_bytes = b"".join(chunks)
        print("      ⌛ Deserializando respuesta JSON...")
        try:
            data = json.loads(raw_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
        except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Error deserializando JSON de la tabla INE {table_id}. "
                f"La respuesta fue truncada o es inválida ({len(raw_bytes)} bytes recibidos). "
                f"Detalle: {e}"
            ) from e
        print(f"      ✓ Respuesta recibida: {len(data)} series de datos crudas obtenidas.")
        return data


// ==========================================
// FILE: scrapers/text_normalizer.py
// ==========================================

"""
Módulo especializado en la normalización y limpieza de cadenas de texto.
Responsabilidad única (SRP): Procesamiento de texto y conversión a slugs válidos.
"""

import re


def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """
    Transforma un texto o nombre en un identificador limpio (slug) sin acentos ni caracteres especiales.
    """
    text = text.lower().strip()
    replacements = {
        "á": "a", "é": "e", "í": "i", "ó": "o", "ú": "u",
        "ñ": "n", "ü": "u", "(": "", ")": "", ",": ""
    }
    for k, v in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(k, v)
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")


// ==========================================
// FILE: scripts/compile-data.ts
// ==========================================

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import * as d3Geo from "d3-geo";
import { IndicatorSchema, type Indicator, type DirectoryIndexItem } from "../src/domain/indicator.schema";

const CONTENT_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "content");
const INDICATORS_DIR = path.join(CONTENT_DIR, "indicators");
const GEO_RAW_PATH = path.join(CONTENT_DIR, "geo", "world-natural-earth.raw.json");
const GENERATED_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "generated");
const DIRECTORY_INDEX_PATH = path.join(GENERATED_DIR, "directory-index.json");
const PROJECTED_WORLD_PATH = path.join(GENERATED_DIR, "projected-world.json");
const PROMPT_TEMPLATE_PATH = path.join(process.cwd(), "PROMPT_TEMPLATE.md");

function roundSvgPath(d: string, decimals = 1): string {
  const regex = new RegExp(`(\\d+\\.\\d{${decimals}})\\d+`, "g");
  return d.replace(regex, "$1");
}

export function compileIndicators(): {
  indicators: Indicator[];
  indexItems: DirectoryIndexItem[];
} {
  console.log("[Compiler] Loading indicators from content/indicators/*.json...");

  if (!fs.existsSync(INDICATORS_DIR)) {
    throw new Error(`Indicators directory not found at ${INDICATORS_DIR}`);
  }

  const files = fs.readdirSync(INDICATORS_DIR).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json"));
  if (files.length === 0) {
    throw new Error("No indicator JSON files found in content/indicators/");
  }

  const indicators: Indicator[] = [];
  const indexItems: DirectoryIndexItem[] = [];

  for (const file of files) {
    const filePath = path.join(INDICATORS_DIR, file);
    const rawContent = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
    let parsedJson: unknown;
    try {
      parsedJson = JSON.parse(rawContent);
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid JSON syntax in ${filePath}: ${(err as Error).message}`);
    }

    // 1. Zod Validation
    const parseResult = IndicatorSchema.safeParse(parsedJson);
    if (!parseResult.success) {
      console.error(`Validation errors in ${file}:`, parseResult.error.format());
      throw new Error(`Indicator schema validation failed for ${file}`);
    }

    const indicator = parseResult.data;

    // 2. Mathematical Invariants Verification
    if (indicator.kind === "immigration-flow") {
      for (const y of indicator.years) {
        const countrySum = Object.values(y.byCountryIso2).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
        const residualSum = Object.values(y.residualByRegion).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
        const totalSum = countrySum + residualSum;
        const diff = Math.abs(totalSum - y.declaredTotal);
        if (diff > 2) {
          throw new Error(
            `Mathematical invariant violated in ${file} for year ${y.year}: ` +
              `countrySum (${countrySum}) + residualSum (${residualSum}) = ${totalSum} != declaredTotal (${y.declaredTotal}) [diff=${diff}]`
          );
        }
      }
    } else if (indicator.kind === "fiscal-balance") {
      if (indicator.points) {
        for (const pt of indicator.points) {
          const revSum = Object.values(pt.stateRevenueMmEur).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
          const spendSum = Object.values(pt.stateSpendingMmEur).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

          if (Math.abs(revSum - pt.totalRevenueMmEur) > 0.1) {
            throw new Error(
              `Revenue invariant violated in ${file} for year ${pt.year}: sum=${revSum.toFixed(2)}, declared=${pt.totalRevenueMmEur}`
            );
          }
          if (Math.abs(spendSum - pt.totalSpendingMmEur) > 0.1) {
            throw new Error(
              `Spending invariant violated in ${file} for year ${pt.year}: sum=${spendSum.toFixed(2)}, declared=${pt.totalSpendingMmEur}`
            );
          }
          if (Math.abs(pt.totalRevenueMmEur - pt.totalSpendingMmEur - pt.deficitMmEur) > 0.1) {
            throw new Error(
              `Deficit invariant violated in ${file} for year ${pt.year}: ` +
                `rev (${pt.totalRevenueMmEur}) - spend (${pt.totalSpendingMmEur}) != deficit (${pt.deficitMmEur})`
            );
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Build precomputed directory index item
    let latestValue = 0;
    let latestPeriod = "";
    let timeHorizon = "";
    let sparkline: number[] = [];

    if (indicator.kind === "time-series") {
      const first = indicator.points[0];
      const last = indicator.points[indicator.points.length - 1];
      latestPeriod = last.period;
      latestValue = last.value;
      timeHorizon = indicator.points.length > 1 ? `${first.period}–${last.period}` : last.period;
      sparkline = indicator.points.map((p) => p.value);
    } else if (indicator.kind === "fiscal-balance") {
      if ((indicator as any).annualBalances && (indicator as any).annualBalances.length > 0) {
        const balances = (indicator as any).annualBalances;
        const first = balances[0];
        const last = balances[balances.length - 1];
        latestPeriod = last.year;
        latestValue = last.metrics?.PC_GDP?.totals?.balance ?? 0;
        timeHorizon = balances.length > 1 ? `${first.year}–${last.year}` : last.year;
        sparkline = balances.map((b: any) => b.metrics?.PC_GDP?.totals?.balance ?? 0);
      } else if (indicator.points && indicator.points.length > 0) {
        const first = indicator.points[0];
        const last = indicator.points[indicator.points.length - 1];
        latestPeriod = last.year;
        latestValue = last.ratio.foreign;
        timeHorizon = indicator.points.length > 1 ? `${first.year}–${last.year}` : last.year;
        sparkline = indicator.points.map((p) => p.ratio.foreign);
      }
    } else if (indicator.kind === "immigration-flow") {
      const first = indicator.years[0];
      const last = indicator.years[indicator.years.length - 1];
      latestPeriod = last.year;
      latestValue = last.declaredTotal;
      timeHorizon = indicator.years.length > 1 ? `${first.year}–${last.year}` : last.year;
      sparkline = indicator.years.map((y) => y.declaredTotal);
    } else if (indicator.kind === "nationality-indicators") {
      const records = (indicator as any).annualRecords;
      const first = records[0];
      const last = records[records.length - 1];
      latestPeriod = last.year;
      latestValue = last.definitions?.citizenship?.demographics?.foreigners?.shareOfTotalPct ?? 0;
      timeHorizon = records.length > 1 ? `${first.year}–${last.year}` : last.year;
      sparkline = records.map((r: any) => r.definitions?.citizenship?.demographics?.foreigners?.shareOfTotalPct ?? 0);
    }

    const primarySource = {
      es: indicator.sources[0].institution.es,
      en: indicator.sources[0].institution.en,
    };

    const searchSummary = {
      es: indicator.contextNotes.es[0] ?? indicator.question.es,
      en: indicator.contextNotes.en[0] ?? indicator.question.en,
    };

    indexItems.push({
      id: indicator.id,
      kind: indicator.kind,
      category: indicator.category,
      question: indicator.question,
      unit: indicator.unit,
      valueFormat: indicator.valueFormat,
      latestValue,
      latestPeriod,
      timeHorizon,
      primarySource,
      searchSummary,
      sparkline,
    });

    indicators.push(indicator);
  }

  // Ensure generated directory exists
  fs.mkdirSync(GENERATED_DIR, { recursive: true });

  // Write directory index
  fs.writeFileSync(DIRECTORY_INDEX_PATH, JSON.stringify(indexItems, null, 2));
  console.log(`[Compiler] Generated ${DIRECTORY_INDEX_PATH} with ${indexItems.length} indicators.`);

  // Sync to public/data for external API consumers / static CDN access
  const publicDataDir = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "data");
  const publicItemsDir = path.join(publicDataDir, "items");
  fs.mkdirSync(publicItemsDir, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(publicDataDir, "items.json"), JSON.stringify(indexItems, null, 2));
  for (const ind of indicators) {
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(publicItemsDir, `${ind.id}.json`), JSON.stringify(ind, null, 2));
  }

  return { indicators, indexItems };
}

export function compileGeoMap(): void {
  console.log("[Compiler] Pre-projecting world geography from raw GeoJSON...");

  if (!fs.existsSync(GEO_RAW_PATH)) {
    console.warn(`[Compiler] Raw GeoJSON not found at ${GEO_RAW_PATH}, skipping map compilation.`);
    return;
  }

  const rawGeo = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(GEO_RAW_PATH, "utf-8"));
  const width = 1000;
  const height = 520;

  // Visual honesty: Natural Earth projection
  const projection = d3Geo.geoNaturalEarth1().fitSize([width, height], rawGeo as d3Geo.ExtendedFeatureCollection);
  const pathGenerator = d3Geo.geoPath(projection);

  interface ProjectedCountry {
    iso2: string;
    name: string;
    path: string;
  }

  const countries: ProjectedCountry[] = [];
  const rawFeatures = (rawGeo as { features: Array<{ properties: Record<string, any>; geometry: any }> }).features;

  for (const [fIdx, f] of rawFeatures.entries()) {
    const props = f.properties || {};
    let iso2 =
      (props.ISO_A2 && props.ISO_A2 !== "-99" ? props.ISO_A2 : null) ||
      (props.ISO_A2_EH && props.ISO_A2_EH !== "-99" ? props.ISO_A2_EH : null) ||
      (props.ISO_A3 && props.ISO_A3 !== "-99" ? props.ISO_A3 : null);

    if (!iso2 || iso2 === "-99" || iso2.length > 2) {
      iso2 = `FEAT_${fIdx}`;
    }

    const pathD = pathGenerator(f as any);
    if (pathD) {
      countries.push({
        iso2: iso2.toUpperCase(),
        name: props.NAME || props.ADMIN || iso2,
        path: roundSvgPath(pathD, 1),
      });
    }
  }

  // Pre-project graticule lines
  const graticule = d3Geo.geoGraticule10();
  const graticulePath = pathGenerator(graticule);

  const projectedMapAsset = {
    viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
    width,
    height,
    graticulePath: graticulePath ? roundSvgPath(graticulePath, 1) : "",
    countries,
  };

  fs.mkdirSync(GENERATED_DIR, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(PROJECTED_WORLD_PATH, JSON.stringify(projectedMapAsset));
  console.log(
    `[Compiler] Generated ${PROJECTED_WORLD_PATH} with ${countries.length} countries pre-projected.`
  );
}

  const templateContent = `# Template para Generar Secciones de Datos con IA (Gemini)

Este documento contiene la plantilla para generar objetos JSON válidos bajo el nuevo modelo canónico (\`IndicatorSchema\`) e importarlos en \`content/indicators/\`.

FORMATO DE SALIDA:

{
  "id": "slug-en-kebab-case-sin-acentos",
  "kind": "time-series",
  "category": "economy-employment",
  "chartStyle": "line",

// ==========================================
// FILE: scripts/dump-typescript.js
// ==========================================

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const ROOT_DIR = process.cwd();
const OUTPUT_FILE = path.join(ROOT_DIR, "repo-bundle.txt");

const IGNORE_DIRS = ["node_modules", ".next", "out", ".git", "public", "staging", ".venv", ".opencode"];
const IGNORE_FILES = [
  "all-typescript-code.ts",
  "repo-bundle.txt",
  "package-lock.json",
  "uv.lock",
  "countriesGeo.json",
  "landGeo.json",
  "world-natural-earth.raw.json",
  "projected-world.json"
];

const ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = [".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".py", ".css", ".json", ".md", ".toml", ".mjs"];

function shouldIgnore(relPath, fileName) {
  const normalized = relPath.split(path.sep).join("/");
  if (normalized.startsWith("public/") || normalized.startsWith("staging/")) return true;
  if (normalized.startsWith("data/es/")) return true; // duplicate mirror of data/
  if (normalized.includes("countriesGeo.json") || normalized.includes("landGeo.json")) return true;
  if (IGNORE_FILES.includes(fileName)) return true;
  return false;
}

function walkDir(dir, fileList = []) {
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (IGNORE_DIRS.includes(entry.name)) continue;
    const res = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    const relPath = path.relative(ROOT_DIR, res);
    if (shouldIgnore(relPath, entry.name)) continue;

    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      walkDir(res, fileList);
    } else if (entry.isFile()) {
      const ext = path.extname(entry.name);
      if (ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.includes(ext) || ["package.json", "tsconfig.json", "pyproject.toml"].includes(entry.name)) {
        fileList.push(res);
      }
    }
  }
  return fileList;
}

function bundleRepo() {
  const files = walkDir(ROOT_DIR);
  let output = `/**\n * FACTORES REPOSITORY SOURCE CODE BUNDLE\n * Generated on: ${new Date().toISOString()}\n */\n\n`;

  for (const file of files) {
    const relPath = path.relative(ROOT_DIR, file);
    const content = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf-8");
    output += `// ==========================================\n`;
    output += `// FILE: ${relPath}\n`;
    output += `// ==========================================\n\n`;
    output += content;
    output += `\n\n`;
  }

  fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_FILE, output, "utf-8");
  console.log(`[Bundle] Successfully bundled ${files.length} repository source files into ${OUTPUT_FILE}`);
}

bundleRepo();

// ==========================================
// FILE: scripts/validate-and-sync.js
// ==========================================

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const STAGING_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "staging");
const DATA_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "data");
const PUBLIC_DATA_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "data");

function ensureDirs() {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(STAGING_DIR, "items"), { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(DATA_DIR, "items"), { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(DATA_DIR, "es", "items"), { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(DATA_DIR, "en", "items"), { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(PUBLIC_DATA_DIR, "items"), { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(PUBLIC_DATA_DIR, "es", "items"), { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(PUBLIC_DATA_DIR, "en", "items"), { recursive: true });
}

function validateAndBuildIndex() {
  console.log("[Validation] Scanning ./staging/items directory...");
  ensureDirs();

  const itemsDir = path.join(STAGING_DIR, "items");
  const files = fs.existsSync(itemsDir)
    ? fs.readdirSync(itemsDir).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json"))
    : [];

  const indexItems = [];

  for (const file of files) {
    const filePath = path.join(itemsDir, file);
    let item;
    try {
      item = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8"));
    } catch (e) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid JSON syntax in ${filePath}: ${e.message}`);
    }

    if (!item.id || !item.question || !item.category) {
      throw new Error(`Item in ${file} is missing required fields (id, question, category).`);
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(item.sources) || item.sources.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`Item ${file} must include a standardized 'sources' array with at least one source (AC 1.1).`);
    }

    for (const src of item.sources) {
      if (!src.institution || typeof src.institution !== "string") {
        throw new Error(`Source in ${file} is missing required 'institution' string (AC 1.2).`);
      }
      if (!src.title || typeof src.title !== "string") {
        throw new Error(`Source in ${file} is missing required 'title' string (AC 1.2).`);
      }
      if (!src.url || typeof src.url !== "string") {
        throw new Error(`Source in ${file} is missing required 'url' string (AC 1.2).`);
      }
    }

    if (item.conceptGuide) {
      const g = item.conceptGuide;
      if (!g.title || typeof g.title !== "string" || g.title.trim() === "") {
        throw new Error(`Item ${file} conceptGuide.title must be a non-empty string.`);
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(g.terms)) {
        throw new Error(`Item ${file} conceptGuide.terms must be an array.`);
      }
      const categoryIds = new Set(Array.isArray(g.categories) ? g.categories.map((c) => c.id) : []);
      const seenCodes = new Set();
      for (const t of g.terms) {
        if (!t.code || typeof t.code !== "string" || t.code.trim() === "") {
          throw new Error(`Term in ${file} missing non-empty code.`);
        }
        if (seenCodes.has(t.code)) {
          throw new Error(`Duplicate term code '${t.code}' in ${file} conceptGuide.`);
        }
        seenCodes.add(t.code);
        if (!t.displayCode || !t.title || !t.shortDefinition || !t.explanation) {
          throw new Error(`Term '${t.code}' in ${file} is missing required strings (displayCode, title, shortDefinition, explanation).`);
        }
        if (t.categoryId && !categoryIds.has(t.categoryId)) {
          throw new Error(`Term '${t.code}' in ${file} references unknown categoryId '${t.categoryId}'.`);
        }
      }
    }

    const points = item.dataPoints || (item.metrics && Object.values(item.metrics)[0]?.series);
    if (!Array.isArray(points) || points.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(`Item ${file} must have a non-empty dataPoints or series array.`);
    }

    for (const p of points) {
      const val = p.value;
      if (typeof val === "number") {
        if (Number.isNaN(val) || !Number.isFinite(val)) {
          throw new Error(`Invalid or corrupted numeric value '${val}' in ${file} (NaN/null/Infinity).`);
        }
      } else if (Array.isArray(val)) {
        for (const entry of val) {
          if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object") {
            throw new Error(`Invalid point element in ${file}: expected object, got ${typeof entry}`);
          }
          for (const [k, num] of Object.entries(entry)) {
            if (typeof num !== "number" || Number.isNaN(num) || !Number.isFinite(num)) {
              throw new Error(`Invalid numeric value '${num}' for key '${k}' in ${file}.`);
            }
          }
        }
      } else {
        throw new Error(`Invalid value type '${typeof val}' in ${file}. Expected number or array of objects.`);
      }

      const dateVal = p.year || p.date;
      if (!dateVal) {
        throw new Error(`Data point in ${file} missing year/date field.`);
      }
    }

    const lastPoint = points[points.length - 1];
    let latestVal = 0;
    if (typeof lastPoint.value === "number") {
      latestVal = lastPoint.value;
    } else if (Array.isArray(lastPoint.value)) {
      const totalObj = lastPoint.value.find((v) => v && typeof v === "object" && "total" in v) || lastPoint.value[0];
      latestVal = totalObj ? Object.values(totalObj)[0] : 0;
    }

    const firstSource = item.sources?.[0] || item.source;
    indexItems.push({
      id: item.id,
      category: item.category,
      question: item.question,
      unit: item.unit || "",
      latestValue: latestVal,
      latestYear: lastPoint.year || lastPoint.date,
      lastUpdated: firstSource?.lastUpdated || item.last_updated || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]
    });
  }

  // Write items index and metadata
  const metadata = {
    last_updated: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    total_items: indexItems.length,
    categories: ["Vivienda", "Economía y Empleo", "Sanidad", "Pensiones y Demografía"]
  };

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(STAGING_DIR, "items.json"), JSON.stringify(indexItems, null, 2));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(STAGING_DIR, "metadata.json"), JSON.stringify(metadata, null, 2));

  console.log(`[Validation] Validated ${indexItems.length} items successfully.`);
}

function copyRecursive(src, dest) {
  if (fs.existsSync(dest)) {
    fs.rmSync(dest, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
  fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true });

  const entries = fs.readdirSync(src, { withFileTypes: true });
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const srcPath = path.join(src, entry.name);
    const destPath = path.join(dest, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      copyRecursive(srcPath, destPath);
    } else {
      fs.copyFileSync(srcPath, destPath);
    }
  }
}

function sync() {
  console.log("[Sync] Syncing ./staging to ./data...");
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(DATA_DIR, "items"), { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(DATA_DIR, "es", "items"), { recursive: true });

  copyRecursive(path.join(STAGING_DIR, "items"), path.join(DATA_DIR, "items"));
  copyRecursive(path.join(STAGING_DIR, "items"), path.join(DATA_DIR, "es", "items"));

  if (fs.existsSync(path.join(STAGING_DIR, "metadata.json"))) {
    fs.copyFileSync(path.join(STAGING_DIR, "metadata.json"), path.join(DATA_DIR, "metadata.json"));
    fs.copyFileSync(path.join(STAGING_DIR, "metadata.json"), path.join(DATA_DIR, "es", "metadata.json"));
  }
  if (fs.existsSync(path.join(STAGING_DIR, "items.json"))) {
    fs.copyFileSync(path.join(STAGING_DIR, "items.json"), path.join(DATA_DIR, "items.json"));
    fs.copyFileSync(path.join(STAGING_DIR, "items.json"), path.join(DATA_DIR, "es", "items.json"));
  }

  console.log("[Sync] Syncing ./data to ./public/data...");
  fs.mkdirSync(PUBLIC_DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });
  copyRecursive(DATA_DIR, PUBLIC_DATA_DIR);

  const publicEnDir = path.join(PUBLIC_DATA_DIR, "en");
  const dataEnDir = path.join(DATA_DIR, "en");
  if (fs.existsSync(dataEnDir)) {
    copyRecursive(dataEnDir, publicEnDir);
  }

  // Sync canonical indicator to content/indicators for Next.js SSG
  const nationalityStagingPath = path.join(STAGING_DIR, "items", "indicadores-nacionalidad-espana.json");
  const contentIndicatorsDir = path.join(process.cwd(), "content", "indicators");
  if (fs.existsSync(nationalityStagingPath) && fs.existsSync(contentIndicatorsDir)) {
    const rawStaging = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(nationalityStagingPath, "utf-8"));
    const contentPayload = {
      id: rawStaging.id,
      kind: "nationality-indicators",
      category: "economy-employment",
      valueFormat: "percent",
      question: {
        es: rawStaging.question,
        en: "How do demographics, employment, and income compare between Spanish and foreign populations in Spain?",
      },
      unit: {
        es: rawStaging.unit,
        en: "% foreign population",
      },
      contextNotes: {
        es: rawStaging.contextNotes,
        en: [
          "All indicators trace directly to official statistics from Spain's INE transmitted to Eurostat (Padrón/ECP, EPA, ECV, and Acquisitions of Citizenship), without synthetic imputations.",
          "Classification by nationality (passport) reflects legal status in each year; annual acquisitions of Spanish citizenship transition foreign-born residents into the Spanish national group.",
          "Labor market indicators (activity, employment, unemployment rates, and employed persons) correspond to the population aged 15 to 64 according to harmonized EPA / LFS criteria.",
          "Equivalised net income (ECV / EU-SILC) adjusts disposable household income for household size and composition using the modified OECD equivalence scale to compare individual purchasing power.",
        ],
      },
      sources: rawStaging.sources.map((s) => ({
        institution: { es: s.institution, en: s.institution },
        title: { es: s.title, en: s.title },
        shortName: { es: s.shortName, en: s.shortName },
        tableId: s.tableId,
        period: s.period,
        lastUpdated: s.lastUpdated,
        url: s.url,
      })),
      lastUpdated: rawStaging.last_updated || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      conceptGuide: rawStaging.conceptGuide,
      annualRecords: rawStaging.annualRecords,
      dataPoints: rawStaging.dataPoints,
    };
    fs.writeFileSync(
      path.join(contentIndicatorsDir, "indicadores-nacionalidad-espana.json"),
      JSON.stringify(contentPayload, null, 2),
      "utf-8"
    );
    console.log("[Sync] Synced indicadores-nacionalidad-espana.json to content/indicators/");
  }

  console.log("[Sync] Data sync complete!");
}

try {
  validateAndBuildIndex();
  sync();
} catch (err) {
  console.error("[Pipeline Error]", err.message);
  process.exit(1);
}

"use client";

import dynamic from "next/dynamic";
import type { DatoItem, Lang } from "@/types";
import { isFiscalBalanceItem, isNationalityIndicatorsItem } from "@/types";
import { ChartSkeleton } from "@/src/components/visualizations/ChartSkeleton";
import InteractiveChart from "./InteractiveChart";

const FiscalBalanceView = dynamic(
  () => import("./fiscal/FiscalBalanceView"),
  { loading: () => <ChartSkeleton /> }
);

const NationalityIndicatorsView = dynamic(
  () => import("./nationality/NationalityIndicatorsView"),
  { ssr: false, loading: () => <ChartSkeleton /> }
);

const ImmigrationExplorer = dynamic(
  () => import("@/src/components/visualizations/immigration/ImmigrationExplorer"),
  { loading: () => <ChartSkeleton /> }
);

interface ChartRendererProps {
  item: DatoItem | any;
  lang?: Lang;
  locale?: Lang;
}

export function ChartRenderer({ item, lang, locale = "es" }: ChartRendererProps) {
  const activeLang = lang || locale || "es";

  if (isFiscalBalanceItem(item)) {
    return <FiscalBalanceView item={item} lang={activeLang} locale={activeLang} />;
  }

  if (isNationalityIndicatorsItem(item)) {
    return <NationalityIndicatorsView item={item} lang={activeLang} locale={activeLang} />;
  }

  if (item.chartType === "immigration-flow" || "annualBlocks" in item || "blocks" in item) {
    return <ImmigrationExplorer indicator={item} locale={activeLang} />;
  }

  return <InteractiveChart item={item} lang={activeLang} locale={activeLang} />;
}

export default ChartRenderer;

// ==========================================
// FILE: src/components/detail/InteractiveChart.tsx
// ==========================================

"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import {
  ResponsiveContainer,
  LineChart,
  Line,
  BarChart,
  Bar,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  CartesianGrid,
  type TooltipProps,
} from "recharts";
import type { DatoItem, Lang } from "@/types";
import { formatNumber, formatPercent } from "@/lib/format";

interface InteractiveChartProps {
  item: DatoItem;
  lang?: Lang;
  locale?: Lang;
}

interface CustomTooltipProps extends TooltipProps<number, string> {
  unit: string;
  lang: Lang;
}

function StandardTooltip({ active, payload, label, unit, lang }: CustomTooltipProps) {
  if (!active || !payload || !payload.length) return null;
  const entry = payload[0];
  const val = Number(entry.value) || 0;

  const isPercent = unit.includes("%");
  const formattedVal = isPercent ? formatPercent(val, lang) : formatNumber(val, lang);

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white p-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-700 text-xs space-y-1 font-sans">
      <div className="font-semibold text-slate-300">{label}</div>
      <div className="text-sm font-bold text-blue-400 font-mono tabular-nums">
        {formattedVal} {unit ? `(${unit})` : ""}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function InteractiveChart({ item, lang, locale = "es" }: InteractiveChartProps) {
  const activeLang = lang || locale || "es";
  const { chartType, unit } = item;

  // Read data points safely (from dataPoints array or points array)
  const rawPoints = (item as any).dataPoints || (item as any).points || [];

  const data = useMemo(() => {
    return rawPoints.map((pt: any) => ({
      period: pt.year || pt.period || "",
      value: typeof pt.value === "number" ? pt.value : Number(pt.value) || 0,
    }));
  }, [rawPoints]);

  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-12 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
        No hay datos suficientes para mostrar la gráfica.
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isBar = chartType === "bar";

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-xl space-y-3">
      <div className="w-full h-[360px] sm:h-[420px]">
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          {isBar ? (
            <BarChart data={data} margin={{ top: 12, right: 16, left: -10, bottom: 8 }}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1E293B" vertical={false} />
              <XAxis
                dataKey="period"
                stroke="#64748B"
                tick={{ fill: "#94A3B8", fontSize: 11, fontFamily: "monospace" }}
                axisLine={{ stroke: "#334155" }}
                tickLine={false}
              />
              <YAxis
                stroke="#64748B"
                tick={{ fill: "#94A3B8", fontSize: 11, fontFamily: "monospace" }}
                axisLine={{ stroke: "#334155" }}
                domain={[0, (dataMax: number) => Math.ceil(dataMax * 1.1)]}
                tickFormatter={(v: number) => formatNumber(v, activeLang)}
              />
              <Tooltip
                content={<StandardTooltip unit={unit} lang={activeLang} />}
              />
              <Bar dataKey="value" fill="#3B82F6" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} />
            </BarChart>
          ) : (
            <LineChart data={data} margin={{ top: 12, right: 16, left: -10, bottom: 8 }}>
              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#1E293B" vertical={false} />
              <XAxis
                dataKey="period"
                stroke="#64748B"
                tick={{ fill: "#94A3B8", fontSize: 11, fontFamily: "monospace" }}
                axisLine={{ stroke: "#334155" }}
                tickLine={false}
              />
              <YAxis
                stroke="#64748B"
                tick={{ fill: "#94A3B8", fontSize: 11, fontFamily: "monospace" }}
                axisLine={{ stroke: "#334155" }}
                domain={[
                  (dataMin: number) => (dataMin < 0 ? Math.floor(dataMin * 1.1) : 0),
                  (dataMax: number) => Math.ceil(dataMax * 1.1),
                ]}
                tickFormatter={(v: number) => formatNumber(v, activeLang)}
              />
              <Tooltip
                content={<StandardTooltip unit={unit} lang={activeLang} />}
              />
              <Line
                type="monotone"
                dataKey="value"
                stroke="#3B82F6"
                strokeWidth={3}
                dot={{ r: 3, fill: "#3B82F6" }}
                activeDot={{ r: 6, fill: "#60a5fa" }}
              />
            </LineChart>
          )}
        </ResponsiveContainer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default InteractiveChart;

// ==========================================
// FILE: src/components/detail/SourceCard.tsx
// ==========================================

import { ShieldCheck, Calendar, ExternalLink, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
import type { Indicator, Locale } from "@/domain/indicator.schema";
import type { Lang } from "@/types";
import { sanitizeHttpUrl } from "@/lib/url";
import { t } from "@/lib/i18n";

interface SourceCardProps {
  sources?: Indicator["sources"] | any[];
  lastUpdated?: string;
  locale?: Locale;
  lang?: Lang;
}

export function SourceCard({ sources, lastUpdated, locale, lang }: SourceCardProps) {
  const activeLocale: Locale = (lang || locale || "es") as Locale;

  if (!sources || sources.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
          <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
            {t("sourceTitle", activeLocale)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="p-5 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/50 text-center space-y-2">
          <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400 mx-auto" />
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-white">
            {t("noDataYet", activeLocale)}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const uniqueInstitutions = Array.from(
    new Set(
      sources.map((s: any) =>
        typeof s.institution === "object"
          ? s.institution[activeLocale] || s.institution.es
          : s.institution
      ).filter(Boolean)
    )
  );
  const headerInstitution =
    uniqueInstitutions.length > 1
      ? uniqueInstitutions.join(" / ")
      : typeof sources[0]?.institution === "object"
      ? sources[0]?.institution[activeLocale] || sources[0]?.institution.es
      : sources[0]?.institution ?? "";

  const subtitleText =
    sources.length === 1
      ? t("sourcesSubtitleSingle", activeLocale)
      : t("sourcesSubtitleMultiple", activeLocale);

  return (
    <section className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-xl space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
        <span className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
          {sources.length > 1 ? t("sourcesTitle", activeLocale) : t("sourceTitle", activeLocale)}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-1">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">{headerInstitution}</p>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">{subtitleText}</p>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-3">
        {sources.map((s: any, idx: number) => {
          const safeUrl = sanitizeHttpUrl(s.url);
          const instText =
            typeof s.institution === "object"
              ? s.institution[activeLocale] || s.institution.es
              : s.institution;
          const titleText =
            typeof s.title === "object"
              ? s.title[activeLocale] || s.title.es
              : s.title;
          const shortName =
            typeof s.shortName === "object"
              ? s.shortName?.[activeLocale] || s.shortName?.es || titleText
              : s.shortName || titleText;

          const effectiveDate = s.lastUpdated ?? lastUpdated;

          return (
            <div
              key={`${s.tableId ?? "src"}-${idx}`}
              className="p-4 rounded-xl border transition-all flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-950/50 border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-700"
            >
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  {uniqueInstitutions.length > 1 && (
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-400 bg-amber-950/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-800/80">
                      {instText}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white">{titleText}</span>
                  {s.period && (
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-blue-400 bg-blue-950 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-800/80 font-mono">
                      {s.period}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-slate-400 flex-wrap">
                  {s.tableId && (
                    <span className="font-mono text-slate-300 font-semibold">
                      {t("officialTable", activeLocale)} {s.tableId}
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {effectiveDate && (
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Calendar className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" />
                      {t("lastUpdated", activeLocale)}: {effectiveDate}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {safeUrl ? (
                <a
                  href={safeUrl}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold text-blue-300 hover:text-white bg-blue-950 hover:bg-blue-900 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition-colors border border-blue-800/80 shrink-0 w-full sm:w-auto justify-center"
                >
                  <span>{shortName}</span>
                  <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </a>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 italic">URL no disponible</span>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default SourceCard;
