/**
 * Returns chronologically sorted list of years (ascending).
 */
export function getAvailableYears(balances: AnnualBalanceRecord[]): string[] {
  if (!balances || balances.length === 0) return [];
  return balances
    .map((b) => b.year)
    .sort((a, b) => parseInt(a, 10) - parseInt(b, 10));
}

/**
 * Scans from newest to oldest and returns latest year where cofogAvailable === true and metrics exist.
 */
export function getLatestCofogYear(balances: AnnualBalanceRecord[]): string | null {
  if (!balances || balances.length === 0) return null;
  const sorted = [...balances].sort((a, b) => parseInt(b.year, 10) - parseInt(a.year, 10));
  for (const b of sorted) {
    if (b.cofogAvailable && b.metrics?.PC_GDP?.expenditures !== null) {
      return b.year;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Finds requested record and its unit metrics + previous year metrics for YoY calculations.
 */
export function getYearMetrics(
  balances: AnnualBalanceRecord[],
  year: string,
  unit: FiscalUnitId
): { record: AnnualBalanceRecord; metrics: FiscalUnitMetrics; prevMetrics: FiscalUnitMetrics | null } | null {
  if (!balances || balances.length === 0) return null;
  const sorted = [...balances].sort((a, b) => parseInt(a.year, 10) - parseInt(b.year, 10));

  let idx = sorted.findIndex((b) => b.year === year);
  if (idx === -1) {
    idx = sorted.length - 1; // Fallback to latest
  }

  const record = sorted[idx];
  const metrics = record.metrics[unit];
  const prevMetrics = idx > 0 ? sorted[idx - 1].metrics[unit] : null;

  return { record, metrics, prevMetrics };
}

/**
 * Formats a fiscal numeric value based on unit (PC_GDP or MIO_EUR) and locale.
 */
export function formatFiscalValue(
  value: number,
  unit: FiscalUnitId,
  lang: Lang = "es",
  opts?: { signed?: boolean; compact?: boolean }
): string {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || !Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return "—";
  }

  const isEs = lang === "es";

  if (unit === "PC_GDP") {
    const formattedNum = Math.abs(value).toLocaleString(isEs ? "es-ES" : "en-US", {
      minimumFractionDigits: 1,
      maximumFractionDigits: 1,
    });
    const unitSuffix = isEs ? "% PIB" : "% GDP";
    const sign = value < 0 ? "-" : opts?.signed && value > 0 ? "+" : "";
    return `${sign}${formattedNum} ${unitSuffix}`;
  }

  // unit === "MIO_EUR"
  // Eurostat MIO_EUR values are already in millions of euros (e.g. 661500 = 661,5 MM€).
  const absVal = Math.abs(value);
  const sign = value < 0 ? "-" : opts?.signed && value > 0 ? "+" : "";

  if (opts?.compact && absVal >= 1000) {
    const billions = absVal / 1000;
    const formattedB = billions.toLocaleString(isEs ? "es-ES" : "en-US", {
      minimumFractionDigits: 1,
      maximumFractionDigits: 1,
    });
    return isEs ? `${sign}${formattedB} MM€` : `${sign}€${formattedB}B`;
  }

  const formattedM = Math.round(absVal).toLocaleString(isEs ? "es-ES" : "en-US");
  return isEs ? `${sign}${formattedM} M€` : `${sign}€${formattedM}M`;
}

/**
 * Formats a YoY or era delta value with explicit sign.
 */
export function formatFiscalDelta(
  delta: number,
  unit: FiscalUnitId,
  lang: Lang = "es"
): string {
  if (delta === undefined || delta === null || !Number.isFinite(delta)) {
    return "—";
  }

  const isEs = lang === "es";
  const sign = delta > 0 ? "+" : delta < 0 ? "-" : "";

  if (unit === "PC_GDP") {
    const abs = Math.abs(delta).toLocaleString(isEs ? "es-ES" : "en-US", {
      minimumFractionDigits: 1,
      maximumFractionDigits: 1,
    });
    return `${sign}${abs} pp`;
  }

  // MIO_EUR
  const absVal = Math.abs(delta);
  if (absVal >= 1000) {
    const billions = (absVal / 1000).toLocaleString(isEs ? "es-ES" : "en-US", {
      minimumFractionDigits: 1,
      maximumFractionDigits: 1,
    });
    return isEs ? `${sign}${billions} MM€` : `${sign}€${billions}B`;
  }

  const millions = Math.round(absVal).toLocaleString(isEs ? "es-ES" : "en-US");
  return isEs ? `${sign}${millions} M€` : `${sign}€${millions}M`;
}

/**
 * Builds array of macro time series points for Layer 1.
 */
export function buildMacroTimeSeries(
  balances: AnnualBalanceRecord[],
  unit: FiscalUnitId
) {
  if (!balances) return [];
  const sorted = [...balances].sort((a, b) => parseInt(a.year, 10) - parseInt(b.year, 10));
  return sorted.map((b) => {
    const m = b.metrics[unit];
    const revenue = m.totals.revenue;
    const expenditure = m.totals.expenditure;
    const balance = m.totals.balance;
    return {
      year: b.year,
      revenue,
      expenditure,
      balance,
      isSurplus: balance >= 0,
      cofogAvailable: b.cofogAvailable,
    };
  });
}

/**
 * Builds stacked composition series for Recharts AreaChart.
 */
export function buildCompositionSeries(
  balances: AnnualBalanceRecord[],
  taxonomy: FiscalTaxonomy,
  side: "revenues" | "expenditures",
  unit: FiscalUnitId,
  scaleMode: "unit" | "percent"
) {
  if (!balances || !taxonomy) return [];
  const sorted = [...balances].sort((a, b) => parseInt(a.year, 10) - parseInt(b.year, 10));
  const taxa = taxonomy[side];

  return sorted.map((b) => {
    const m = b.metrics[unit];
    const row: Record<string, any> = { year: b.year };

    if (side === "expenditures" && (!b.cofogAvailable || !m.expenditures)) {
      taxa.forEach((t) => {
        row[t.code] = null;
      });
    } else {
      const dataMap = side === "revenues" ? m.revenues : m.expenditures;
      const columnTotal = side === "revenues" ? m.totals.revenue : m.totals.expenditure;

      taxa.forEach((t) => {
        const entry = dataMap ? dataMap[t.code] : null;
        if (!entry || entry.total === undefined || entry.total === null) {
          row[t.code] = null;
        } else {
          row[t.code] =
            scaleMode === "percent" && columnTotal > 0
              ? (entry.total / columnTotal) * 100
              : entry.total;
        }
      });
    }

    return row;
  });
}

/**
 * Builds top-level breakdown for Layer 2 Anatomy Split view.
 */
export function buildAnatomyBreakdown(
  record: AnnualBalanceRecord,
  taxonomy: FiscalTaxonomy,
  unit: FiscalUnitId
): AnatomyBreakdownResult {
  const defaultResult: AnatomyBreakdownResult = {
    revenues: [],
    expenditures: [],
    bridgeItem: null,
    uncollectibleAdjustment: null,
    cofogAvailable: record.cofogAvailable,
  };

  if (!record || !taxonomy) return defaultResult;
  const metrics = record.metrics[unit];
  if (!metrics) return defaultResult;

  const totalRev = metrics.totals.revenue;
  const totalExp = metrics.totals.expenditure;
  const balance = metrics.totals.balance;

  // 1. Revenues Breakdown
  const revenues: AnatomyItem[] = taxonomy.revenues
    .map((taxon) => {
      const entry = metrics.revenues ? metrics.revenues[taxon.code] : null;
      const val = entry?.total ?? 0;
      const sharePct = totalRev > 0 ? (val / totalRev) * 100 : 0;

      const children: AnatomyChildItem[] = taxon.children.map((child) => {
        const childVal = entry?.breakdown ? entry.breakdown[child.code] ?? 0 : 0;
        return {
          code: child.code,
          label: child.label,
          value: childVal,
          shareOfParentPct: val > 0 ? (childVal / val) * 100 : 0,
          shareOfTotalPct: totalRev > 0 ? (childVal / totalRev) * 100 : 0,
        };
      });

      return {
        code: taxon.code,
        label: taxon.label,
        shortLabel: taxon.shortLabel,
        value: val,
        sharePct,
        children,
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

  // 2. Expenditures Breakdown
  let expenditures: AnatomyItem[] = [];
  if (record.cofogAvailable && metrics.expenditures) {
    expenditures = taxonomy.expenditures
      .map((taxon) => {
        const entry = metrics.expenditures ? metrics.expenditures[taxon.code] : null;
        const val = entry?.total ?? 0;
        const sharePct = totalExp > 0 ? (val / totalExp) * 100 : 0;

        const children: AnatomyChildItem[] = taxon.highlights.map((child) => {
          const childVal = entry?.highlights ? entry.highlights[child.code] ?? 0 : 0;
          return {
            code: child.code,
            label: child.label,
            value: childVal,
            shareOfParentPct: val > 0 ? (childVal / val) * 100 : 0,
            shareOfTotalPct: totalExp > 0 ? (childVal / totalExp) * 100 : 0,
          };
        });

        return {
          code: taxon.code,
          label: taxon.label,
          shortLabel: taxon.shortLabel,
          value: val,
          sharePct,
          children,
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);
  }

  // 3. Accounting Bridge Item
  let bridgeItem: BridgeItem | null = null;
  if (balance < 0) {
    // Deficit: added to Revenue side to balance
    const absDef = Math.abs(balance);
    bridgeItem = {
      side: "revenues",
      type: "deficit",
      value: absDef,
      sharePct: totalRev > 0 ? (absDef / totalRev) * 100 : 0,
    };
  } else if (balance > 0) {
    // Surplus: added to Expenditure side to balance
    bridgeItem = {
      side: "expenditures",
      type: "surplus",
      value: balance,
      sharePct: totalExp > 0 ? (balance / totalExp) * 100 : 0,
    };
  }

  const uncollectibleAdjustment =
    Math.abs(metrics.totals.uncollectibleAdjustment ?? 0) > 0.05
      ? metrics.totals.uncollectibleAdjustment ?? null
      : null;

  return {
    revenues,
    expenditures,
    bridgeItem,
    uncollectibleAdjustment,
    cofogAvailable: record.cofogAvailable,
  };
}

/**
 * Computes era comparison between Year A and Year B.
 */
export function computeEraComparison(
  balances: AnnualBalanceRecord[],
  taxonomy: FiscalTaxonomy,
  yearA: string,
  yearB: string,
  side: "revenues" | "expenditures",
  unit: FiscalUnitId
): EraComparisonResult {
  const missingCofogYears: string[] = [];

  const recA = balances.find((b) => b.year === yearA);
  const recB = balances.find((b) => b.year === yearB);

  if (!recA || !recB || !taxonomy) {
    return { items: [], maxAbsDelta: 0, missingCofogYears };
  }

  if (side === "expenditures") {
    if (!recA.cofogAvailable) missingCofogYears.push(yearA);
    if (!recB.cofogAvailable) missingCofogYears.push(yearB);
  }

  if (missingCofogYears.length > 0) {
    return { items: [], maxAbsDelta: 0, missingCofogYears };
  }

  const metricsA = recA.metrics[unit];
  const metricsB = recB.metrics[unit];
  const dataA = side === "revenues" ? metricsA.revenues : metricsA.expenditures;
  const dataB = side === "revenues" ? metricsB.revenues : metricsB.expenditures;
  const totalA = side === "revenues" ? metricsA.totals.revenue : metricsA.totals.expenditure;
  const totalB = side === "revenues" ? metricsB.totals.revenue : metricsB.totals.expenditure;

  const taxa = taxonomy[side];

  let maxAbsDelta = 0;

  const items: EraComparisonItem[] = taxa.map((taxon) => {
    const valA = dataA?.[taxon.code]?.total ?? 0;
    const valB = dataB?.[taxon.code]?.total ?? 0;
    const delta = valB - valA;
    if (Math.abs(delta) > maxAbsDelta) {
      maxAbsDelta = Math.abs(delta);
    }
    return {
      code: taxon.code,
      label: taxon.label,
      shortLabel: taxon.shortLabel,
      valueA: valA,
      valueB: valB,
      delta,
      sharePctA: totalA > 0 ? (valA / totalA) * 100 : 0,
      sharePctB: totalB > 0 ? (valB / totalB) * 100 : 0,
    };
  });

  items.sort((a, b) => b.delta - a.delta);

  return { items, maxAbsDelta, missingCofogYears };
}

/**
 * Pure deterministic SVG geometry calculator for 3-Column Sankey Diagram.
 */
export function buildSankeyGraph(
  record: AnnualBalanceRecord,
  taxonomy: FiscalTaxonomy,
  unit: FiscalUnitId,
  width: number,
  height: number
): SankeyGraphResult {
  if (!record || !taxonomy || !record.cofogAvailable || !record.metrics[unit].expenditures) {
    return { nodes: [], links: [], cofogAvailable: false };
  }

  const metrics = record.metrics[unit];
  const totalRev = metrics.totals.revenue;
  const totalExp = metrics.totals.expenditure;
  const balance = metrics.totals.balance;

  const nodeWidth = 22;
  const paddingTop = 28;
  const paddingBottom = 28;
  const availableH = height - paddingTop - paddingBottom;
  const nodeGap = 10;

  // Prepare Column 0 (Revenues + Deficit Bridge if B.9 < 0)
  type RawSankeyNode = {
    id: string;
    code: string;
    label: string;
    shortLabel: string;
    value: number;
    sharePct: number;
    color: string;
    column: 0 | 1 | 2;
    subNotes: string[];
    isBridge?: boolean;
  };

  const rawRevNodes: RawSankeyNode[] = taxonomy.revenues
    .map((t) => {
      const val = metrics.revenues?.[t.code]?.total ?? 0;
      const subNotes: string[] = [];
      const entry = metrics.revenues?.[t.code];
      if (entry?.breakdown) {
        Object.entries(entry.breakdown).forEach(([c, v]) => {
          const childMeta = t.children.find((ch) => ch.code === c);
          if (childMeta && v > 0) {
            subNotes.push(`${childMeta.label.split("(")[0].trim()}: ${v}`);
          }
        });
      }
      return {
        id: `node-rev-${t.code}`,
        code: t.code,
        label: t.label,
        shortLabel: t.shortLabel,
        value: val,
        sharePct: totalRev > 0 ? (val / totalRev) * 100 : 0,
        color: getTaxonColor(t.code),
        column: 0 as const,
        subNotes,
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

  if (balance < 0) {
    const absDef = Math.abs(balance);
    rawRevNodes.push({
      id: "node-bridge-deficit",
      code: "DEFICIT_BRIDGE",
      label: "Necesidad de financiación (Déficit B.9)",
      shortLabel: "Déficit B.9",
      value: absDef,
      sharePct: totalRev > 0 ? (absDef / totalRev) * 100 : 0,
      color: DEFICIT_BRIDGE,
      column: 0 as const,
      subNotes: ["Financiación mediante endeudamiento neto"],
      isBridge: true,
    });
  }

  const col0Total = rawRevNodes.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n.value, 0);

  // Layout Column 0
  const col0Gaps = (rawRevNodes.length - 1) * nodeGap;
  const col0HeightBudget = availableH - col0Gaps;

  let currentY0 = paddingTop;
  const col0Nodes: SankeyNode[] = rawRevNodes.map((n) => {
    const nodeH = col0Total > 0 ? Math.max(8, (n.value / col0Total) * col0HeightBudget) : 8;
    const node: SankeyNode = {
      ...n,
      x: 0,
      y: currentY0,
      width: nodeWidth,
      height: nodeH,
    };
    currentY0 += nodeH + nodeGap;
    return node;
  });

  // Prepare Column 2 (Expenditures + Surplus Bridge if B.9 > 0)
  const rawExpNodes: RawSankeyNode[] = taxonomy.expenditures
    .map((t) => {
      const val = metrics.expenditures?.[t.code]?.total ?? 0;
      const subNotes: string[] = [];
      const entry = metrics.expenditures?.[t.code];
      if (entry?.highlights) {
        Object.entries(entry.highlights).forEach(([c, v]) => {
          const childMeta = t.highlights.find((ch) => ch.code === c);
          if (childMeta && v > 0) {
            subNotes.push(`${childMeta.label.split("(")[0].trim()}: ${v}`);
          }
        });
      }
      return {
        id: `node-exp-${t.code}`,
        code: t.code,
        label: t.label,
        shortLabel: t.shortLabel,
        value: val,
        sharePct: totalExp > 0 ? (val / totalExp) * 100 : 0,
        color: getTaxonColor(t.code),
        column: 2 as const,
        subNotes,
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value);

  if (balance > 0) {
    rawExpNodes.push({
      id: "node-bridge-surplus",
      code: "SURPLUS_BRIDGE",
      label: "Capacidad de financiación (Superávit B.9)",
      shortLabel: "Superávit B.9",
      value: balance,
      sharePct: totalExp > 0 ? (balance / totalExp) * 100 : 0,
      color: SURPLUS_BRIDGE,
      column: 2 as const,
      subNotes: ["Capacidad neta de desendeudamiento"],
      isBridge: true,
    });
  }

  const col2Total = rawExpNodes.reduce((sum, n) => sum + n.value, 0);

  // Layout Column 2
  const col2Gaps = (rawExpNodes.length - 1) * nodeGap;
  const col2HeightBudget = availableH - col2Gaps;
  const xCol2 = width - nodeWidth;

  let currentY2 = paddingTop;
  const col2Nodes: SankeyNode[] = rawExpNodes.map((n) => {
    const nodeH = col2Total > 0 ? Math.max(8, (n.value / col2Total) * col2HeightBudget) : 8;
    const node: SankeyNode = {
      ...n,
      x: xCol2,
      y: currentY2,
      width: nodeWidth,
      height: nodeH,
    };
    currentY2 += nodeH + nodeGap;
    return node;
  });

  // Column 1 Hub: Central Government S.13
  const hubX = Math.round(width / 2 - nodeWidth / 2);
  const hubNode: SankeyNode = {
    id: "node-hub-s13",
    code: "S13",
    label: "Administraciones Públicas (Consolidado AAPP S.13)",
    shortLabel: "AAPP Consolidado",
    value: Math.max(totalRev, totalExp),
    sharePct: 100,
    x: hubX,
    y: paddingTop,
    width: nodeWidth,
    height: availableH,
    color: "#64748B",
    column: 1,
    subNotes: [
      `Ingresos Totales: ${totalRev}`,
      `Gastos Totales: ${totalExp}`,
      `Saldo Fiscal B.9: ${balance >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${balance}`,
    ],
  };

  const nodes: SankeyNode[] = [...col0Nodes, hubNode, ...col2Nodes];
  const links: SankeyLink[] = [];

  // Left Links: Col 0 -> Col 1 Hub
  let hubLeftY = paddingTop;
  col0Nodes.forEach((srcNode) => {
    const x0 = srcNode.x + srcNode.width;
    const y0 = srcNode.y;
    const h = srcNode.height;
    const x1 = hubNode.x;
    const y1 = hubLeftY;
    const cx = (x0 + x1) / 2;

    const path = `M ${x0} ${y0} C ${cx} ${y0}, ${cx} ${y1}, ${x1} ${y1} L ${x1} ${y1 + h} C ${cx} ${
      y1 + h
    }, ${cx} ${y0 + h}, ${x0} ${y0 + h} Z`;

    links.push({
      id: `link-left-${srcNode.code}`,
      sourceId: srcNode.id,
      targetId: hubNode.id,
      value: srcNode.value,
      color: srcNode.color,
      path,
    });

    hubLeftY += h;
  });

  // Right Links: Col 1 Hub -> Col 2
  let hubRightY = paddingTop;
  col2Nodes.forEach((tgtNode) => {
    const x0 = hubNode.x + hubNode.width;
    const y0 = hubRightY;
    const h = tgtNode.height;
    const x1 = tgtNode.x;
    const y1 = tgtNode.y;
    const cx = (x0 + x1) / 2;

    const path = `M ${x0} ${y0} C ${cx} ${y0}, ${cx} ${y1}, ${x1} ${y1} L ${x1} ${y1 + h} C ${cx} ${
      y1 + h
    }, ${cx} ${y0 + h}, ${x0} ${y0 + h} Z`;

    links.push({
      id: `link-right-${tgtNode.code}`,
      sourceId: hubNode.id,
      targetId: tgtNode.id,
      value: tgtNode.value,
      color: tgtNode.color,
      path,
    });

    hubRightY += h;
  });

  return { nodes, links, cofogAvailable: true };
}

// FILE: src/components/detail/guide/ConceptGuideContext.tsx
// ==========================================

"use client";

import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useMemo,
  useState,
  useCallback,
  useRef,
  useEffect,
} from "react";
import type { ConceptGuide, GlossaryTerm } from "@/types";

interface ConceptGuideContextValue {
  guide: ConceptGuide | null;
  getTerm: (code: string) => GlossaryTerm | undefined;
  activeConceptCode: string | null;
  highlightedConceptCode: string | null;
  focusConcept: (code: string) => void;
  clearActiveConcept: () => void;
}

const ConceptGuideContext = createContext<ConceptGuideContextValue>({
  guide: null,
  getTerm: () => undefined,
  activeConceptCode: null,
  highlightedConceptCode: null,
  focusConcept: () => {},
  clearActiveConcept: () => {},
});

export interface ConceptGuideProviderProps {
  guide?: ConceptGuide | null;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function ConceptGuideProvider({ guide = null, children }: ConceptGuideProviderProps) {
  const [activeConceptCode, setActiveConceptCode] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [highlightedConceptCode, setHighlightedConceptCode] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const highlightTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  const termMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, GlossaryTerm>();
    if (guide?.terms) {
      for (const term of guide.terms) {
        map.set(term.code, term);
        map.set(term.code.trim().toUpperCase(), term);
        map.set(term.displayCode, term);
        map.set(term.displayCode.trim().toUpperCase(), term);
      }
    }
    return map;
  }, [guide]);

  const getTerm = useCallback(
    (code: string) => {
      if (!code) return undefined;
      return (
        termMap.get(code) ||
        termMap.get(code.trim().toUpperCase()) ||
        termMap.get(code.replace(".", "")) ||
        termMap.get(code.replace(".", "").toUpperCase())
      );
    },
    [termMap]
  );

  const clearActiveConcept = useCallback(() => {
    setActiveConceptCode(null);
    setHighlightedConceptCode(null);
  }, []);

  const focusConcept = useCallback((code: string) => {
    setActiveConceptCode(code);
    setHighlightedConceptCode(code);

    if (highlightTimerRef.current !== null) {
      window.clearTimeout(highlightTimerRef.current);
    }

    highlightTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
      setHighlightedConceptCode(null);
      highlightTimerRef.current = null;
    }, 2200);

    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const el = document.getElementById(`concept-${code}`);
      if (el) {
        const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
        el.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: prefersReducedMotion ? "auto" : "smooth",
          block: "center",
        });
      }
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (highlightTimerRef.current !== null) {
        window.clearTimeout(highlightTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      guide,
      getTerm,
      activeConceptCode,
      highlightedConceptCode,
      focusConcept,
      clearActiveConcept,
    }),
    [guide, getTerm, activeConceptCode, highlightedConceptCode, focusConcept, clearActiveConcept]
  );

  return (
    <ConceptGuideContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </ConceptGuideContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useConceptGuide() {
  return useContext(ConceptGuideContext);
}

"use client";

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  BookOpen,
  Search,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronRight,
  Info,
  ArrowRight,
  Filter,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { Lang, GlossaryTerm } from "@/types";
import { useConceptGuide } from "./ConceptGuideContext";
import { t } from "@/lib/i18n";

interface ConceptGuideSectionProps {
  lang?: Lang;
}

export function ConceptGuideSection({ lang = "es" }: ConceptGuideSectionProps) {
  const { guide, activeConceptCode, highlightedConceptCode, focusConcept } = useConceptGuide();

  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>("all");
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>("");
  const [expandedCodes, setExpandedCodes] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  // Sync activeConceptCode from context (e.g., when triggered from a popover or chart)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeConceptCode) {
      setExpandedCodes((prev) => ({ ...prev, [activeConceptCode]: true }));
      // Reset filter and search if active concept is hidden
      setSelectedCategory("all");
      setSearchQuery("");
    }
  }, [activeConceptCode]);

  if (!guide) return null;

  const { title, subtitle, quickKeys, categories, terms } = guide;

  // Filter terms by selected category and search query
  const filteredTerms = useMemo(() => {
    return terms.filter((term) => {
      // Category check
      if (selectedCategory !== "all" && term.categoryId !== selectedCategory) {
        return false;
      }
      // Search check
      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
        const codeMatch = term.code.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const displayMatch = term.displayCode.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const titleMatch = term.title.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const shortMatch = term.shortDefinition.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const expMatch = term.explanation.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        return codeMatch || displayMatch || titleMatch || shortMatch || expMatch;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [terms, selectedCategory, searchQuery]);

  const toggleExpand = (code: string) => {
    setExpandedCodes((prev) => ({ ...prev, [code]: !prev[code] }));
  };

  const isAllExpanded =
    filteredTerms.length > 0 &&
    filteredTerms.every((term) => expandedCodes[term.code]);

  const toggleAll = () => {
    if (isAllExpanded) {
      setExpandedCodes({});
    } else {
      const next: Record<string, boolean> = {};
      filteredTerms.forEach((term) => {
        next[term.code] = true;
      });
      setExpandedCodes(next);
    }
  };

  // Term counts per category for filter pills
  const categoryCounts = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    map.set("all", terms.length);
    for (const term of terms) {
      map.set(term.categoryId, (map.get(term.categoryId) || 0) + 1);
    }
    return map;
  }, [terms]);

  return (
    <section className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-6 shadow-xl animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      {/* Section Header */}
      <div className="border-b border-slate-800 pb-4 space-y-1">
        <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
          <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
          <span>{title}</span>
        </h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 leading-relaxed max-w-3xl">
          {subtitle}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* PART 1: Quick-Reading Keys (Claves) */}
      {quickKeys && quickKeys.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
            {t("quickKeysHeading", lang)}
          </h3>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3.5">
            {quickKeys.map((keyCard) => (
              <div
                key={keyCard.id}
                className="bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2 hover:border-slate-700 transition-all"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-blue-300 bg-blue-950/80 border border-blue-800/70 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                    {keyCard.badge}
                  </span>
                  <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white leading-tight">
                    {keyCard.title}
                  </h4>
                </div>

                <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                  {keyCard.summary}
                </p>

                {keyCard.example && (
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 border-l-2 border-slate-700 pl-2.5 pt-0.5 italic">
                    {keyCard.example}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* PART 2: Interactive Technical Glossary */}
      <div className="space-y-4 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <h3 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-300">
            {t("glossaryHeading", lang)}
          </h3>

          <button
            onClick={toggleAll}
            className="text-xs font-semibold text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 transition-colors self-end sm:self-auto"
          >
            {isAllExpanded ? t("collapseAll", lang) : t("expandAll", lang)}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Filter & Search Bar */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-stretch md:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          {/* Category Filter Pills */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
            <button
              onClick={() => setSelectedCategory("all")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                selectedCategory === "all"
                  ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs"
                  : "bg-slate-950 text-slate-400 hover:text-white border border-slate-800"
              }`}
            >
              {t("glossaryAll", lang)} ({categoryCounts.get("all") || 0})
            </button>

            {categories.map((cat) => {
              const count = categoryCounts.get(cat.id) || 0;
              const isSelected = selectedCategory === cat.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={cat.id}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat.id)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                    isSelected
                      ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs"
                      : "bg-slate-950 text-slate-400 hover:text-white border border-slate-800"
                  }`}
                >
                  {cat.label} ({count})
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Search Input */}
          <div className="relative min-w-[240px] md:w-72">
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t("glossarySearchPlaceholder", lang)}
              className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500/80 transition-colors"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Terms Accordion List */}
        {filteredTerms.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 italic">
            {t("glossaryNoMatches", lang)}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {filteredTerms.map((term) => {
              const isExpanded = !!expandedCodes[term.code];
              const isHighlighted = highlightedConceptCode === term.code;

              return (
                <div
                  key={term.code}
                  id={`concept-${term.code}`}
                  className={`scroll-mt-24 rounded-xl border transition-all duration-300 ${
                    isHighlighted
                      ? "ring-2 ring-blue-500 border-blue-500/80 bg-blue-950/40"
                      : "bg-slate-950/60 border-slate-800/80 hover:border-slate-700"
                  }`}
                >
                  {/* Collapsed Header Row */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleExpand(term.code)}
                    aria-expanded={isExpanded}
                    aria-controls={`concept-content-${term.code}`}
                    className="w-full text-left p-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 cursor-pointer select-none focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <span className="min-w-[68px] text-center text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-blue-300 bg-blue-950 border border-blue-800/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded shrink-0">
                        {term.displayCode}
                      </span>

                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate">
                        {term.title}
                      </span>

                      {!isExpanded && (
                        <span className="hidden sm:inline text-xs text-slate-400 truncate max-w-xs font-normal">
                          · {term.shortDefinition}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-slate-400 shrink-0">
                      {isExpanded ? (
                        <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
                      ) : (
                        <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {/* Expanded Content Body */}
                  {isExpanded && (
                    <div
                      id={`concept-content-${term.code}`}
                      className="px-3 pb-3.5 pt-1 border-t border-slate-800/60 space-y-2.5 animate-in fade-in duration-150"
                    >
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
                        {term.explanation}
                      </p>

                      {term.keyNote && (
                        <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-2.5 flex items-start gap-2 text-[11px] text-slate-300 leading-normal">
                          <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                          <span>{term.keyNote}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {term.relatedCodes && term.relatedCodes.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap pt-1 text-[11px]">
                          <span className="text-slate-400 font-semibold">
                            {t("relatedConcepts", lang)}
                          </span>
                          {term.relatedCodes.map((relCode) => (
                            <button
                              key={relCode}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                focusConcept(relCode);
                              }}
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono font-bold text-blue-300 bg-blue-950/80 hover:bg-blue-900 border border-blue-800/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded transition-colors"
                            >
                              <span>{relCode}</span>
                              <ArrowRight className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default ConceptGuideSection;

// FILE: src/components/detail/guide/ConceptHelpTrigger.tsx
// ==========================================

"use client";

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useId, useCallback } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { HelpCircle, ArrowDown } from "lucide-react";
import type { Lang } from "@/types";
import { useConceptGuide } from "./ConceptGuideContext";
import { t } from "@/lib/i18n";

interface ConceptHelpTriggerProps {
  code: string;
  lang?: Lang;
  className?: string;
}

interface PopoverCoords {
  top?: number;
  bottom?: number;
  left: number;
  width: number;
}

export function ConceptHelpTrigger({
  code,
  lang = "es",
  className = "",
}: ConceptHelpTriggerProps) {
  const { getTerm, focusConcept } = useConceptGuide();
  const term = getTerm(code);

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
  const [coords, setCoords] = useState<PopoverCoords | null>(null);

  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const popoverRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const popoverId = useId();

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);

  const updatePosition = useCallback(() => {
    if (!triggerRef.current) return;
    const rect = triggerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const popoverWidth = Math.min(290, typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.innerWidth - 24 : 290);

    // Horizontal positioning: align to right of trigger, or clamp within viewport
    let left = rect.right - popoverWidth;
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      if (left < 12) {
        left = Math.max(12, rect.left);
      }
      if (left + popoverWidth > window.innerWidth - 12) {
        left = window.innerWidth - popoverWidth - 12;
      }
    }

    // Vertical positioning: if enough space above (> 170px), place above; else place below
    const spaceAbove = rect.top;
    const spaceBelow = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.innerHeight - rect.bottom : 300;

    if (spaceAbove > 170 || spaceAbove > spaceBelow) {
      setCoords({
        bottom: typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.innerHeight - rect.top + 8 : 0,
        left,
        width: popoverWidth,
      });
    } else {
      setCoords({
        top: rect.bottom + 8,
        left,
        width: popoverWidth,
      });
    }
  }, []);

  const togglePopover = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isOpen) {
      updatePosition();
      setIsOpen(true);
    } else {
      setIsOpen(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFocusFullGuide = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsOpen(false);
    focusConcept(code);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    const handleScrollOrResize = () => {
      updatePosition();
    };

    const handlePointerDown = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      if (
        popoverRef.current &&
        !popoverRef.current.contains(event.target as Node) &&
        triggerRef.current &&
        !triggerRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)
      ) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") {
        setIsOpen(false);
        triggerRef.current?.focus();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScrollOrResize, true);
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleScrollOrResize);
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", handlePointerDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScrollOrResize, true);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", handleScrollOrResize);
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", handlePointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isOpen, updatePosition]);

  if (!term) return null;

  const popoverContent = isOpen && coords && mounted && (
    <div
      ref={popoverRef}
      id={popoverId}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="false"
      aria-label={term.title}
      style={{
        position: "fixed",
        top: coords.top !== undefined ? `${coords.top}px` : "auto",
        bottom: coords.bottom !== undefined ? `${coords.bottom}px` : "auto",
        left: `${coords.left}px`,
        width: `${coords.width}px`,
        zIndex: 9999,
      }}
      className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl p-3 shadow-2xl text-xs space-y-2 font-sans animate-in fade-in duration-150"
      onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
    >
      {/* Popover Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-800 pb-1.5">
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-blue-300 bg-blue-950 border border-blue-800/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded shrink-0">
          {term.displayCode}
        </span>
        <span className="font-bold text-white text-xs truncate">
          {term.title}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Short Definition */}
      <p className="text-slate-300 leading-snug">
        {term.shortDefinition}
      </p>

      {/* Footer Action: Jump to full guide */}
      <div className="pt-1 border-t border-slate-800/80 text-right">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleFocusFullGuide}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 transition-colors"
        >
          <span>{t("seeFullGuide", lang)}</span>
          <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className={`relative inline-flex items-center shrink-0 ${className}`}>
      <button
        ref={triggerRef}
        type="button"
        onClick={togglePopover}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        aria-controls={popoverId}
        aria-label={`${t("conceptHelpAria", lang)} ${term.displayCode}: ${term.title}`}
        className="p-1 rounded-full text-slate-500 hover:text-blue-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-400/80 transition-colors shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
      >
        <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
      </button>

      {mounted && popoverContent && createPortal(popoverContent, document.body)}
    </div>
  );
}

export default ConceptHelpTrigger;

// FILE: src/components/detail/nationality/DemographicStructureView.tsx

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { Users, Briefcase, Award } from "lucide-react";
import type { NationalityAnnualRecord, PopulationDefinition, Lang } from "@/types";
import {
  getRecordForYear,
  buildRepresentationComparison,
  buildNaturalizationsSeries,
  formatHeadcount,
  formatExactNumber,
  formatPercent,
} from "./nationalitySelectors";
import {
  NATIONALS_COLOR,
  FOREIGNERS_COLOR,
  NATURALIZATIONS_COLOR,
  AGE_BAND_COLORS,
} from "./nationalityPalette";
import { t } from "@/lib/i18n";
import { ConceptHelpTrigger } from "@/components/detail/guide/ConceptHelpTrigger";

interface DemographicStructureViewProps {
  records: NationalityAnnualRecord[];
  selectedYear: string;
  onSelectYear: (year: string) => void;
  definition: PopulationDefinition;
  lang?: Lang;
}

export function DemographicStructureView({
  records,
  selectedYear,
  onSelectYear,
  definition,
  lang = "es",
}: DemographicStructureViewProps) {
  const currentRecord = getRecordForYear(records, selectedYear);
  const isCitizenship = definition === "citizenship";

  const slice = currentRecord?.definitions?.[definition];
  const demoNat = slice?.demographics?.nationals;
  const demoFor = slice?.demographics?.foreigners;

  const repRows = buildRepresentationComparison(currentRecord, definition);
  const naturalizationsData = buildNaturalizationsSeries(records);

  // Cumulative naturalizations up to selectedYear
  const currentNatPoint = naturalizationsData.find((p) => p.year === selectedYear);
  const latestCumNat = naturalizationsData[naturalizationsData.length - 1]?.cumulativeSinceStart ?? 0;

  const natGroupLabel = isCitizenship ? t("groupNationals", lang) : t("groupNativeBorn", lang);
  const forGroupLabel = isCitizenship ? t("groupForeigners", lang) : t("groupForeignBorn", lang);

  const natBands = demoNat?.ageBands;
  const forBands = demoFor?.ageBands;

  const maxNatYearVal = Math.max(
    ...naturalizationsData.map((d) => d.naturalizations ?? 0),
    1
  );

  return (
    <section className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-xl space-y-6">
      {/* Section Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-800 gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-400" />
          <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
            {t("demographicStructureTitle", lang)} · {t("yearLabel", lang)} {selectedYear}
          </h2>
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">
          {isCitizenship
            ? (lang === "en" ? "INE Continuous Population Statistics (Padrón / ECP)" : "INE Estadística Continua de Población / Padrón")
            : (lang === "en" ? "INE Population by Country of Birth" : "INE Población por País de Nacimiento")}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2-Column Responsive Layout */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 lg:gap-8">
        {/* Left Column: Pirámide de edad (3 tramos) */}
        <div className="bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
                {t("agePyramidTitle", lang)}
              </span>
              <ConceptHelpTrigger code="AGE_STRUCTURE" lang={lang} />
              <ConceptHelpTrigger code="WORKING_AGE" lang={lang} />
            </div>
            {/* Age Band Mini Legend */}
            <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-xs" style={{ backgroundColor: AGE_BAND_COLORS.under15 }} />
                &lt;15
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-xs" style={{ backgroundColor: AGE_BAND_COLORS.workingAge15to64 }} />
                15–64
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-xs" style={{ backgroundColor: AGE_BAND_COLORS.senior65plus }} />
                65+
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Group 1: Nacionales */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: NATIONALS_COLOR }} />
                {natGroupLabel} ({formatHeadcount(demoNat?.population, lang)})
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                <span>{t("dependencyRatioLabel", lang)}:</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-200">{demoNat?.oldAgeDependencyRatio ?? "—"}</span>
                <ConceptHelpTrigger code="DEPENDENCY_RATIO" lang={lang} />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Stacked bar */}
            {natBands ? (
              <div className="h-7 w-full bg-slate-900 rounded-lg overflow-hidden flex font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-950">
                <div
                  style={{ width: `${natBands.under15Pct}%`, backgroundColor: AGE_BAND_COLORS.under15 }}
                  className="h-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300"
                  title={`<15: ${natBands.under15Pct}% (${formatHeadcount(natBands.under15, lang)})`}
                >
                  {natBands.under15Pct > 8 && `${natBands.under15Pct}%`}
                </div>
                <div
                  style={{ width: `${natBands.workingAge15to64Pct}%`, backgroundColor: AGE_BAND_COLORS.workingAge15to64 }}
                  className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-white transition-all duration-300"
                  title={`15–64: ${natBands.workingAge15to64Pct}% (${formatHeadcount(natBands.workingAge15to64, lang)})`}
                >
                  {natBands.workingAge15to64Pct > 12 && `${natBands.workingAge15to64Pct}%`}
                </div>
                <div
                  style={{ width: `${natBands.senior65plusPct}%`, backgroundColor: AGE_BAND_COLORS.senior65plus }}
                  className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-slate-950 transition-all duration-300"
                  title={`65+: ${natBands.senior65plusPct}% (${formatHeadcount(natBands.senior65plus, lang)})`}
                >
                  {natBands.senior65plusPct > 8 && `${natBands.senior65plusPct}%`}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="h-7 bg-slate-900/50 rounded-lg animate-pulse" />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Group 2: Extranjeros */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: FOREIGNERS_COLOR }} />
                {forGroupLabel} ({formatHeadcount(demoFor?.population, lang)})
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                <span>{t("dependencyRatioLabel", lang)}:</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-200">{demoFor?.oldAgeDependencyRatio ?? "—"}</span>
                <ConceptHelpTrigger code="DEPENDENCY_RATIO" lang={lang} />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Stacked bar */}
            {forBands ? (
              <div className="h-7 w-full bg-slate-900 rounded-lg overflow-hidden flex font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-950">
                <div
                  style={{ width: `${forBands.under15Pct}%`, backgroundColor: AGE_BAND_COLORS.under15 }}
                  className="h-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300"
                  title={`<15: ${forBands.under15Pct}% (${formatHeadcount(forBands.under15, lang)})`}
                >
                  {forBands.under15Pct > 8 && `${forBands.under15Pct}%`}
                </div>
                <div
                  style={{ width: `${forBands.workingAge15to64Pct}%`, backgroundColor: AGE_BAND_COLORS.workingAge15to64 }}
                  className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-white transition-all duration-300"
                  title={`15–64: ${forBands.workingAge15to64Pct}% (${formatHeadcount(forBands.workingAge15to64, lang)})`}
                >
                  {forBands.workingAge15to64Pct > 12 && `${forBands.workingAge15to64Pct}%`}
                </div>
                <div
                  style={{ width: `${forBands.senior65plusPct}%`, backgroundColor: AGE_BAND_COLORS.senior65plus }}
                  className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-slate-950 transition-all duration-300"
                  title={`65+: ${forBands.senior65plusPct}% (${formatHeadcount(forBands.senior65plus, lang)})`}
                >
                  {forBands.senior65plusPct > 8 && `${forBands.senior65plusPct}%`}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="h-7 bg-slate-900/50 rounded-lg animate-pulse" />
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400/90 leading-relaxed pt-1">
            {lang === "en"
              ? "The high concentration of the foreign population in working ages (15–64) translates into a very low old-age dependency ratio, reducing the country's average demographic aging."
              : "La alta concentración de la población extranjera en tramos de edad laboral activa (15–64) se traduce en una reducida tasa de dependencia de mayores, compensando el envejecimiento demográfico medio del país."}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right Column: Representation Comparison + Naturalizations */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Representation Bars */}
          <div className="bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
                {t("representationTitle", lang)}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-amber-400 font-semibold">
                {forGroupLabel}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 pt-1">
              {repRows.map((row) => (
                <div key={row.labelKey} className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <span className="text-slate-300">{t(row.labelKey, lang)}</span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-mono">
                      {row.foreignCount !== undefined && (
                        <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px]">
                          {formatHeadcount(row.foreignCount, lang)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span className="font-bold text-amber-400 tabular-nums">
                        {formatPercent(row.foreignSharePct, 1, lang)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-2.5 w-full bg-slate-900 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-amber-400 rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                      style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(0, row.foreignSharePct))}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Naturalizations Strip */}
          <div className="bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Award className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
                <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
                  {t("naturalizationsTitle", lang)}
                </span>
                <ConceptHelpTrigger code="NATURALIZATION" lang={lang} />
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs text-purple-400 font-mono font-bold">
                2008–{naturalizationsData[naturalizationsData.length - 1]?.year}: {formatHeadcount(latestCumNat, lang)}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400">
              <span>
                {selectedYear}:{" "}
                <strong className="text-white font-mono">
                  {currentNatPoint?.naturalizations !== null && currentNatPoint?.naturalizations !== undefined
                    ? formatExactNumber(currentNatPoint.naturalizations, lang)
                    : (lang === "en" ? "Pending publication" : "Pendiente de publicación")}
                </strong>
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                {lang === "en" ? "Click year to inspect" : "Haz clic para cambiar año"}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Interactive mini bar chart */}
            <div className="h-10 flex items-end gap-1 pt-1">
              {naturalizationsData.map((d) => {
                const isActive = d.year === selectedYear;
                const hPct = d.naturalizations ? Math.max(12, Math.round((d.naturalizations / maxNatYearVal) * 100)) : 6;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={d.year}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onSelectYear(d.year)}
                    title={`${d.year}: ${d.naturalizations ? formatExactNumber(d.naturalizations, lang) : "—"}`}
                    className={`flex-1 rounded-xs transition-all relative group ${
                      isActive
                        ? "bg-purple-400 ring-2 ring-purple-300 ring-offset-1 ring-offset-slate-950"
                        : "bg-purple-900/60 hover:bg-purple-500/80"
                    }`}
                    style={{ height: `${hPct}%` }}
                  >
                    <span className="sr-only">{d.year}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export default DemographicStructureView;

// FILE: src/components/detail/nationality/IncomeAndConditionsPanel.tsx

"use client";

import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  ResponsiveContainer,
  LineChart,
  Line,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  ReferenceLine,
  CartesianGrid,
} from "recharts";
import { Wallet, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
import type { NationalityAnnualRecord, PopulationDefinition, Lang } from "@/types";
import {
  buildLivingConditionsSeries,
  getRecordForYear,
  type LivingConditionsMetricKey,
  formatCurrencyEur,
  formatPercent,
} from "./nationalitySelectors";
import {
  NATIONALS_COLOR,
  FOREIGNERS_COLOR,
  EU_FOREIGNERS_COLOR,
  NON_EU_FOREIGNERS_COLOR,
} from "./nationalityPalette";
import { t } from "@/lib/i18n";
import { ConceptHelpTrigger } from "@/components/detail/guide/ConceptHelpTrigger";

interface IncomeAndConditionsPanelProps {
  records: NationalityAnnualRecord[];
  selectedYear: string;
  onSelectYear: (year: string) => void;
  definition: PopulationDefinition;
  lang?: Lang;
}

export function IncomeAndConditionsPanel({
  records,
  selectedYear,
  onSelectYear,
  definition,
  lang = "es",
}: IncomeAndConditionsPanelProps) {
  const [metric, setMetric] = useState<LivingConditionsMetricKey>("medianEquivalisedIncomeEur");

  const currentRecord = getRecordForYear(records, selectedYear);
  const livStats = currentRecord?.livingConditions;

  const data = buildLivingConditionsSeries(records, metric, true);

  const isCurrency = metric !== "atRiskOfPovertyPct";

  const formatYAxis = (val: number) => {
    if (!isCurrency) return `${val}%`;
    if (val >= 1000) return `${(val / 1000).toFixed(0)}k€`;
    return `${val}€`;
  };

  const formatTooltipVal = (val: number | null | undefined) => {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return "—";
    if (isCurrency) return formatCurrencyEur(val, lang);
    return formatPercent(val, 1, lang);
  };

  const handleChartClick = (e: any) => {
    if (e && e.activeLabel) {
      onSelectYear(String(e.activeLabel));
    }
  };

  // Metric values for selectedYear summary
  const natVal = livStats?.nationals?.[metric];
  const forVal = livStats?.foreigners?.[metric];
  const euVal = livStats?.euForeigners?.[metric];
  const nonEuVal = livStats?.nonEuForeigners?.[metric];

  let incomeRatio: number | null = null;
  if (natVal !== null && natVal !== undefined && forVal !== null && forVal !== undefined && natVal > 0) {
    incomeRatio = Math.round((forVal / natVal) * 1000) / 10;
  }

  return (
    <section className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-xl space-y-5">
      {/* Header and Controls */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-slate-800 gap-4">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Wallet className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-400" />
            <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-tight">
              {t("livingConditionsTitle", lang)}
            </h2>
            <ConceptHelpTrigger code="EQUIVALISED_INCOME" lang={lang} />
            <ConceptHelpTrigger code="AROP_RATE" lang={lang} />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            {lang === "en"
              ? "Living Conditions Survey (EU-SILC / INE ECV, adult population 18+)"
              : "Encuesta de Condiciones de Vida (INE ECV / EU-SILC, adultos 18+ años)"}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Metric Switcher Tabs (only relevant when definition === "citizenship") */}
        {definition === "citizenship" && (
          <div
            role="group"
            aria-label="Selección de métrica de condiciones de vida"
            className="inline-flex items-center p-1 bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl flex-wrap"
          >
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMetric("medianEquivalisedIncomeEur")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                metric === "medianEquivalisedIncomeEur"
                  ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
              }`}
            >
              {t("metricMedianIncome", lang)}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMetric("meanEquivalisedIncomeEur")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                metric === "meanEquivalisedIncomeEur"
                  ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
              }`}
            >
              {t("metricMeanIncome", lang)}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMetric("atRiskOfPovertyPct")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
                metric === "atRiskOfPovertyPct"
                  ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-sm"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200"
              }`}
            >
              {t("metricPovertyRate", lang)}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* When definition === "birthplace", ECV data does not exist by country of birth: show only the notice and NO chart */}
      {definition === "birthplace" ? (
        <div className="bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-6 sm:p-8 text-center space-y-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-amber-400">
            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div className="max-w-xl mx-auto space-y-2">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">
              {lang === "en"
                ? "No official data by country of birth"
                : "Sin datos oficiales por país de nacimiento"}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
              {t("citizenshipOnlyNotice", lang)}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* 2-Column Layout (only rendered when definition === "citizenship") */
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        {/* Left 2 Cols: Historical Line Chart */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-400">
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-300">
              {t("historicalEvolution", lang)} (2008–{data[data.length - 1]?.year})
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: NATIONALS_COLOR }} />
                {t("groupNationals", lang)}
              </span>
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: FOREIGNERS_COLOR }} />
                {t("groupForeigners", lang)}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="h-72 w-full pt-1">
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <LineChart
                data={data}
                onClick={handleChartClick}
                margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: 0, bottom: 0 }}
              >
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="#334155" opacity={0.4} />
                <XAxis
                  dataKey="year"
                  stroke="#64748b"
                  fontSize={12}
                  tickLine={false}
                  axisLine={{ stroke: "#334155" }}
                />
                <YAxis
                  stroke="#64748b"
                  fontSize={12}
                  tickLine={false}
                  axisLine={{ stroke: "#334155" }}
                  domain={["auto", "auto"]}
                  tickFormatter={formatYAxis}
                  width={52}
                />
                <Tooltip
                  content={({ active, payload, label }) => {
                    if (!active || !payload || !payload.length) return null;
                    return (
                      <div className="bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-3 shadow-2xl text-xs space-y-1.5 min-w-44">
                        <div className="font-bold text-white border-b border-slate-800 pb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span>{t("yearLabel", lang)} {label}</span>
                          {label === selectedYear && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-blue-400 font-normal">● Activo</span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        {payload.map((entry: any) => (
                          <div key={entry.name} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-300">
                              <span
                                className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full inline-block"
                                style={{ backgroundColor: entry.color }}
                              />
                              {entry.name}:
                            </span>
                            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white tabular-nums">
                              {formatTooltipVal(entry.value)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    );
                  }}
                />

                <ReferenceLine
                  x={selectedYear}
                  stroke="#818CF8"
                  strokeDasharray="4 4"
                  strokeWidth={1.5}
                />

                <Line
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="nationals"
                  name={t("groupNationals", lang)}
                  stroke={NATIONALS_COLOR}
                  strokeWidth={2.5}
                  dot={{ r: 2, fill: NATIONALS_COLOR }}
                  activeDot={{ r: 5 }}
                  connectNulls={false}
                />
                <Line
                  type="monotone"
                  dataKey="foreigners"
                  name={t("groupForeigners", lang)}
                  stroke={FOREIGNERS_COLOR}
                  strokeWidth={2.5}
                  dot={{ r: 2, fill: FOREIGNERS_COLOR }}
                  activeDot={{ r: 5 }}
                  connectNulls={false}
                />
              </LineChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right 1 Col: Summary Card */}
        <div className="bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider pb-2 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>{t("summaryYear", lang)} {selectedYear}</span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-normal text-slate-400 lowercase font-mono">
                {metric === "medianEquivalisedIncomeEur" && (lang === "en" ? "median" : "mediana")}
                {metric === "meanEquivalisedIncomeEur" && (lang === "en" ? "mean" : "media")}
                {metric === "atRiskOfPovertyPct" && (lang === "en" ? "poverty" : "pobreza")}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 pt-3">
              {/* Españoles */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: NATIONALS_COLOR }} />
                  {t("groupNationals", lang)}:
                </span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white text-sm tabular-nums">
                  {formatTooltipVal(natVal)}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Extranjeros */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: FOREIGNERS_COLOR }} />
                  {t("groupForeigners", lang)}:
                </span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-amber-400 text-sm tabular-nums">
                  {formatTooltipVal(forVal)}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Ratio */}
              {incomeRatio !== null && (
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/80 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <span className="text-slate-400">{t("incomeRatioLabel", lang)}:</span>
                  <span className="font-mono font-bold text-purple-300 tabular-nums">
                    {incomeRatio}%
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Desglose UE vs No-UE */}
              {(euVal !== null || nonEuVal !== null) && (
                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-800/80 space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 block font-semibold">
                    {lang === "en" ? "Foreign breakdown:" : "Desglose extranjeros:"}
                  </span>
                  {euVal !== null && euVal !== undefined && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-300 pl-1">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: EU_FOREIGNERS_COLOR }} />
                        {t("groupEuForeigners", lang)}:
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-200">
                        {formatTooltipVal(euVal)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {nonEuVal !== null && nonEuVal !== undefined && (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-300 pl-1">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px]">
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: NON_EU_FOREIGNERS_COLOR }} />
                        {t("groupNonEuForeigners", lang)}:
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums text-slate-200">
                        {formatTooltipVal(nonEuVal)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400/90 leading-relaxed pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/60">
            {lang === "en"
              ? "Equivalised net income measures household disposable income adjusted for household size (modified OECD scale) to allow genuine personal purchasing power comparisons."
              : "La renta neta equivalente mide los ingresos disponibles ajustados por el tamaño familiar (escala modificada OCDE) para comparar el poder adquisitivo individual real."}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

export default IncomeAndConditionsPanel;
