    });
  });

  describe("helpers: getAvailableYears & getLatestCofogYear", () => {
    it("returns sorted years and latest COFOG year", () => {
      const balances = [mockNoCofogRecord, mockSurplusRecord, mockDeficitRecord];
      expect(getAvailableYears(balances)).toEqual(["2006", "2024", "2025"]);
      expect(getLatestCofogYear(balances)).toBe("2024");
    });
  });
});


// ==========================================
// FILE: tests/format.test.ts
// ==========================================

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import {
  formatNumber,
  formatCompactNumber,
  formatPercent,
  formatCurrency,
  formatIndicatorValue,
} from "../src/lib/format";

describe("Locale-Aware Number Formatters", () => {
  describe("formatNumber", () => {
    it("formats thousands separator in Spanish (period)", () => {
      expect(formatNumber(1250000, "es")).toBe("1.250.000");
    });

    it("formats thousands separator in English (comma)", () => {
      expect(formatNumber(1250000, "en")).toBe("1,250,000");
    });

    it("handles 0 and non-finite values safely", () => {
      expect(formatNumber(0, "es")).toBe("0");
      expect(formatNumber(NaN, "es")).toBe("0");
      expect(formatNumber(Infinity, "es")).toBe("0");
    });
  });

  describe("formatCompactNumber", () => {
    it("formats compact notation in Spanish", () => {
      expect(formatCompactNumber(500, "es")).toBe("500");
      expect(formatCompactNumber(1500, "es")).toBe("2 mil");
      expect(formatCompactNumber(1500000, "es")).toBe("1,5 M");
      expect(formatCompactNumber(2500000000, "es")).toBe("2,5 MM");
    });

    it("formats compact notation in English", () => {
      expect(formatCompactNumber(500, "en")).toBe("500");
      expect(formatCompactNumber(1500, "en")).toBe("1.5K");
      expect(formatCompactNumber(1500000, "en")).toBe("1.5M");
      expect(formatCompactNumber(2500000000, "en")).toBe("2.5B");
    });
  });

  describe("formatPercent", () => {
    it("formats percentages with 1 decimal by default", () => {
      expect(formatPercent(187.0, "es")).toBe("187,0%");
      expect(formatPercent(187.0, "en")).toBe("187.0%");
    });

    it("formats percentages with custom decimal places", () => {
      expect(formatPercent(45.678, "es", 2)).toBe("45,68%");
      expect(formatPercent(45.678, "en", 2)).toBe("45.68%");
    });
  });

  describe("formatCurrency", () => {
    it("formats currency in EUR", () => {
      expect(formatCurrency(1500, "es", "eur")).toBe("1.500 €");
      expect(formatCurrency(1500, "en", "eur")).toBe("1,500 €");
    });

    it("formats currency in MM€", () => {
      expect(formatCurrency(661.5, "es", "mmeur")).toBe("661,5 MM€");
      expect(formatCurrency(661.5, "en", "mmeur")).toBe("661.5 MM€");
    });
  });

  describe("formatIndicatorValue", () => {
    it("formats according to ValueFormat enum", () => {
      expect(formatIndicatorValue(187, "percent", "es")).toBe("187,0%");
      expect(formatIndicatorValue(1288562, "number", "es", false)).toBe("1.288.562");
      expect(formatIndicatorValue(1288562, "number", "es", true)).toBe("1,3 M");
    });
  });
});

    expect(years).toEqual(["2023", "2024"]);
  });

  it("getLatestCompleteYear returns latest complete year", () => {
    const latest = getLatestCompleteYear(mockRecords, "citizenship");
    expect(latest).toBe("2024");
  });

  it("getHeadlineKpis calculates YoY delta properly for 2024", () => {
    const kpis = getHeadlineKpis(mockRecords, "2024", "citizenship", "es");
    // Pop: 13.4% vs 12.5% in 2023 = +0,90 pp
    expect(kpis.popKpi.foreignValue).toBe("13,4%");
    expect(kpis.popKpi.yoyDelta).toBe("+0,90 pp");

    // Working age: 83.1% vs 81.7% in 2023 = +1,4 pp
    expect(kpis.workingAgeKpi.foreignValue).toBe("83,1%");
    expect(kpis.workingAgeKpi.yoyDelta).toBe("+1,4 pp");

    // Employment rate: 62.3% vs 62.0% in 2023 = +0,3 pp
    expect(kpis.employmentKpi.foreignValue).toBe("62,3%");
    expect(kpis.employmentKpi.yoyDelta).toBe("+0,3 pp");

    // Median income: 13.800 € vs 13.500 € = +300 €
    expect(kpis.incomeKpi.foreignValue).toBe("13.800 €");
    expect(kpis.incomeKpi.yoyDelta).toBe("+300 €");
    expect(kpis.incomeKpi.notice).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("getHeadlineKpis handles birthplace definition and notice", () => {
    const kpis = getHeadlineKpis(mockRecords, "2024", "birthplace", "es");
    expect(kpis.popKpi.foreignValue).toBe("18,1%");
    expect(kpis.incomeKpi.notice).toBe("ECV oficial por pasaporte");
  });

  it("getHeadlineKpis handles missing previous year gracefully without NaN", () => {
    const kpisFirstYear = getHeadlineKpis(mockRecords, "2023", "citizenship", "es");
    expect(kpisFirstYear.popKpi.yoyDelta).toBeNull();
    expect(kpisFirstYear.employmentKpi.yoyDelta).toBeNull();
    expect(kpisFirstYear.incomeKpi.yoyDelta).toBeNull();
  });

  it("buildRepresentationComparison returns 3 share rows without NaN", () => {
    const comp = buildRepresentationComparison(mockRecords[1], "citizenship");
    expect(comp.length).toBe(3);
    expect(comp[0].labelKey).toBe("totalPopulation");
    expect(comp[0].foreignSharePct).toBe(13.4);
    expect(comp[1].labelKey).toBe("workingAgeShare");
    expect(comp[1].foreignSharePct).toBe(16.8);
    expect(comp[2].labelKey).toBe("employedShare");
    expect(comp[2].foreignSharePct).toBe(15.0);
  });

  it("buildLaborTimeSeries formats chart rows and handles EU split", () => {
    const seriesWithEu = buildLaborTimeSeries(mockRecords, "citizenship", "employmentRatePct", true);
    expect(seriesWithEu.length).toBe(2);
    expect(seriesWithEu[1].foreigners).toBe(62.3);
    expect(seriesWithEu[1].nationals).toBe(66.8);
    expect(seriesWithEu[1].euForeigners).toBe(69.5);
    expect(seriesWithEu[1].nonEuForeigners).toBe(59.9);

    const seriesWithoutEu = buildLaborTimeSeries(mockRecords, "citizenship", "employmentRatePct", false);
    expect(seriesWithoutEu[1].euForeigners).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("buildNaturalizationsSeries calculates cumulative sum", () => {
    const natSeries = buildNaturalizationsSeries(mockRecords);
    expect(natSeries.length).toBe(2);
    expect(natSeries[0].cumulativeSinceStart).toBe(240000);

  });

  it("buildLivingConditionsSeries calculates income ratio", () => {

// ==========================================
// FILE: tests/sanitize-url.test.ts
// ==========================================

import { describe, it, expect } from "vitest";
import { sanitizeHttpUrl } from "../src/lib/url";

describe("sanitizeHttpUrl Security Function", () => {
  it("permits standard https:// URLs", () => {
    const url = "https://www.ine.es/jaxiT3/Tabla.htm?t=56951";
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl(url)).toBe(url);
  });

  it("permits standard http:// URLs", () => {
    const url = "http://datos.gob.es/catalogo";
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl(url)).toBe(url);
  });

  it("blocks javascript: XSS attack vectors", () => {
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl("javascript:alert(1)")).toBeNull();
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl("JAVASCRIPT:document.location='http://evil.com'")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("blocks data: URI attack vectors", () => {
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl("data:text/html,<script>alert(1)</script>")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("blocks file: and vbscript: URIs", () => {
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl("file:///etc/passwd")).toBeNull();
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl("vbscript:msgbox(1)")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("handles null, undefined, whitespace, and non-URL strings safely", () => {
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl(null)).toBeNull();
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl(undefined)).toBeNull();
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl("")).toBeNull();
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl("   ")).toBeNull();
    expect(sanitizeHttpUrl("not a valid url")).toBeNull();
  });
});


// ==========================================
// FILE: tests/test_cuentas_publicas.py
// ==========================================

"""
Pruebas unitarias para el cliente Eurostat y el pipeline de Cuentas Públicas de España.
Utiliza unittest con fixtures sintéticos (sin llamadas de red en vivo).
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest
import math

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from scrapers.eurostat_client import parse_jsonstat, EurostatDataset
from scrapers.cuentas_publicas import build_cuentas_publicas_payload


class TestCuentasPublicas(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_parse_jsonstat_sparse_dict(self):
        payload = {
            "version": "2.0",
            "class": "dataset",
            "id": ["unit", "time"],
            "size": [2, 2],
            "dimension": {
                "unit": {
                    "category": {"index": {"MIO_EUR": 0, "PC_GDP": 1}}
                },
                "time": {
                    "category": {"index": {"2023": 0, "2024": 1}}
                }
            },
            "value": {
                "0": 100.5,  # MIO_EUR, 2023 (flat_idx 0 = unit 0, time 0)
                "3": 45.2    # PC_GDP, 2024 (flat_idx 3 = unit 1, time 1)
            },
            "updated": "2026-10-21T12:00:00+0200"
        }
        ds = parse_jsonstat(payload, "test_ds")
        self.assertEqual(ds.code, "test_ds")
        self.assertEqual(ds.updated, "2026-10-21")
        self.assertEqual(len(ds.records), 2)
        self.assertEqual(ds.records[0], {"unit": "MIO_EUR", "time": "2023", "value": 100.5})
        self.assertEqual(ds.records[1], {"unit": "PC_GDP", "time": "2024", "value": 45.2})

    def test_parse_jsonstat_dense_list(self):
        payload = {
            "version": "2.0",
            "class": "dataset",
            "id": ["na_item", "time"],
            "size": [1, 3],
            "dimension": {
                "na_item": {
                    "category": {"index": ["TR"]}
                },
                "time": {
                    "category": {"index": ["2022", "2023", "2024"]}
                }
            },
            "value": [500.0, None, 600.0],
            "updated": "2026-10-21T12:00:00"
        }
        ds = parse_jsonstat(payload, "test_dense")
        self.assertEqual(len(ds.records), 2)
        self.assertEqual(ds.records[0], {"na_item": "TR", "time": "2022", "value": 500.0})
        self.assertEqual(ds.records[1], {"na_item": "TR", "time": "2024", "value": 600.0})

    def test_reconciliation_passes_and_computes_residual(self):
        config = {
            "indicatorId": "cuentas-publicas-espana",
            "category": "Economía y Empleo",
            "question": "¿Test pregunta?",
            "chartType": "fiscal-balance",
            "headlineUnit": "% del PIB",
            "geo": "ES",
            "sector": "S13",
            "startYear": 2023,
            "units": [
                {"id": "MIO_EUR", "label": "Millones de €", "decimals": 1},
                {"id": "PC_GDP", "label": "% del PIB", "decimals": 2}
            ],
            "taxonomy": {"revenues": [], "expenditures": []},
            "sources": [
                {"datasetKey": "aggregates", "institution": "Inst A", "shortName": "A", "title": "T1", "url": "https://example.com/1"},
                {"datasetKey": "expenditures", "institution": "Inst B", "shortName": "B", "title": "T2", "url": "https://example.com/2"},
                {"datasetKey": "revenues", "institution": "Inst C", "shortName": "C", "title": "T3", "url": "https://example.com/3"},
                {"datasetKey": None, "institution": "Inst D", "shortName": "D", "title": "T4", "url": "https://example.com/4"}
            ]
        }

        # 2 años completos: 2023 y 2024 (requiere al menos 10 años en producción, pero en test podemos mockear o ajustar validación si es necesario,
        # o proveer 10 años para pasar el chequeo de validación).
        # Creemos 10 años de 2015 a 2024 para satisfacer len(valid_years) >= 10.
        years = [str(y) for y in range(2015, 2025)]

        main_recs = []
        tax_recs = []
        exp_recs = []

        for y in years:
            for uid in ["MIO_EUR", "PC_GDP"]:
                scale = 1000.0 if uid == "MIO_EUR" else 40.0
                main_recs.extend([
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "TR", "value": 500.0 * (scale/40)},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "TE", "value": 550.0 * (scale/40)},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "B9", "value": -50.0 * (scale/40)},
                ])
                tax_recs.extend([
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D2", "value": 150.0 * (scale/40)},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D5", "value": 150.0 * (scale/40)},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D61", "value": 100.0 * (scale/40)},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D91", "value": 20.0 * (scale/40)},
                ])
                divs = [f"GF0{i}" if i < 10 else "GF10" for i in range(1, 11)]
                # Suma de 10 divisiones igual a TE (550.0 * (scale/40)) => 55.0 cada una si son 10
                part = (550.0 * (scale/40)) / 10.0
                for div in divs:
                    exp_recs.append({
                        "geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "cofog99": div, "value": part
                    })

        ds_main = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_main", updated="2026-10-21", records=main_recs)
        ds_tax = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_taxag", updated="2026-10-21", records=tax_recs)
        ds_exp = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_exp", updated="2026-10-21", records=exp_recs)

        config["startYear"] = 2015
        payload = build_cuentas_publicas_payload(config, ds_main, ds_tax, ds_exp)

        self.assertEqual(payload["id"], "cuentas-publicas-espana")
        self.assertEqual(len(payload["dataPoints"]), 10)
        self.assertTrue(payload["annualBalances"][0]["cofogAvailable"])
        self.assertIn("sources", payload)
        self.assertEqual(payload["sources"][0]["period"], "2015-2024")

    def test_latest_year_missing_cofog_graceful(self):
        config = {
            "indicatorId": "cuentas-publicas-espana",
            "category": "Economía y Empleo",
            "question": "¿Test?",
            "chartType": "fiscal-balance",
            "headlineUnit": "% del PIB",
            "geo": "ES",
            "sector": "S13",
            "startYear": 2015,
            "units": [
                {"id": "MIO_EUR", "label": "Millones de €", "decimals": 1},
                {"id": "PC_GDP", "label": "% del PIB", "decimals": 2}
            ],
            "taxonomy": {"revenues": [], "expenditures": []},
            "sources": []
        }
        years = [str(y) for y in range(2015, 2025)]
        main_recs = []
        tax_recs = []
        exp_recs = []

        for y in years:
            for uid in ["MIO_EUR", "PC_GDP"]:
                scale = 1000.0 if uid == "MIO_EUR" else 40.0
                main_recs.extend([
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "TR", "value": 500.0 * (scale/40)},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "TE", "value": 550.0 * (scale/40)},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "B9", "value": -50.0 * (scale/40)},
                ])
                tax_recs.extend([
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D2", "value": 150.0 * (scale/40)},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D5", "value": 150.0 * (scale/40)},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D61", "value": 100.0 * (scale/40)},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D91", "value": 20.0 * (scale/40)},
                ])
                # COFOG para todos excepto 2024
                if y != "2024":
                    divs = [f"GF0{i}" if i < 10 else "GF10" for i in range(1, 11)]
                    part = (550.0 * (scale/40)) / 10.0
                    for div in divs:
                        exp_recs.append({
                            "geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "cofog99": div, "value": part
                        })

        ds_main = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_main", updated="2026-10-21", records=main_recs)
        ds_tax = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_taxag", updated="2026-10-21", records=tax_recs)
        ds_exp = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_exp", updated="2026-10-21", records=exp_recs)

        payload = build_cuentas_publicas_payload(config, ds_main, ds_tax, ds_exp)
        # Verificar que 2024 tiene cofogAvailable = False y expenditures = None
        bal_2024 = [b for b in payload["annualBalances"] if b["year"] == "2024"][0]
        self.assertFalse(bal_2024["cofogAvailable"])
        self.assertIsNone(bal_2024["metrics"]["MIO_EUR"]["expenditures"])

    def test_reconciliation_mismatch_raises(self):
        config = {
            "indicatorId": "cuentas-publicas-espana",
            "category": "Economía y Empleo",
            "question": "¿Test?",
            "chartType": "fiscal-balance",
            "headlineUnit": "% del PIB",
            "geo": "ES",
            "sector": "S13",
            "startYear": 2023,
            "units": [
                {"id": "MIO_EUR", "label": "Millones de €", "decimals": 1},
                {"id": "PC_GDP", "label": "% del PIB", "decimals": 2}
            ],
            "taxonomy": {"revenues": [], "expenditures": []},
            "sources": []
        }
        years = [str(y) for y in range(2015, 2025)]
        main_recs = []
        tax_recs = []
        exp_recs = []

        for y in years:
            for uid in ["MIO_EUR", "PC_GDP"]:
                # Romper B9 intencionadamente (TR - TE != B9)
                b9_val = -999.0 if y == "2024" else -50.0
                main_recs.extend([
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "TR", "value": 500.0},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "TE", "value": 550.0},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "B9", "value": b9_val},
                ])
                tax_recs.extend([
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D2", "value": 150.0},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D5", "value": 150.0},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D61", "value": 100.0},
                    {"geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "na_item": "D91", "value": 20.0},
                ])
                divs = [f"GF0{i}" if i < 10 else "GF10" for i in range(1, 11)]
                for div in divs:
                    exp_recs.append({
                        "geo": "ES", "sector": "S13", "unit": uid, "time": y, "cofog99": div, "value": 55.0
                    })

        ds_main = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_main", updated="2026-10-21", records=main_recs)
        ds_tax = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_taxag", updated="2026-10-21", records=tax_recs)
        ds_exp = EurostatDataset(code="gov_10a_exp", updated="2026-10-21", records=exp_recs)
        config["startYear"] = 2015

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_cuentas_publicas_payload(config, ds_main, ds_tax, ds_exp)

            self.assertTrue(math.isfinite(pt["value"]))

"""
Pruebas unitarias para el pipeline de Indicadores de Nacionalidad y Origen (Factor.es).
Ejecución offline con fixtures sintéticos sin llamadas de red.
"""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from scrapers.eurostat_client import EurostatDataset
from scrapers.indicadores_nacionalidad import (
    build_nationality_indicators_payload,
    validate_concept_guide,
)


def make_mock_datasets(years: list[str], corrupt_unemp: bool = False, corrupt_income: bool = False, omit_latest_lag: bool = False) -> dict[str, EurostatDataset]:
    pop_ctz_recs = []
    pop_birth_recs = []
    emp_ctz_recs = []
    emp_birth_recs = []
    act_ctz_recs = []
    act_birth_recs = []
    empr_ctz_recs = []
    empr_birth_recs = []
    unemp_ctz_recs = []
    unemp_birth_recs = []
    acq_recs = []
    inc_ctz_recs = []
    inc_tot_recs = []
    pov_ctz_recs = []
    pov_tot_recs = []

    for idx, y in enumerate(years):
        # 40M total, 35M nat, 5M for
        # under15: 5M nat, 1M for
        # 15-64: 22M nat, 3.8M for
        # 65+: 8M nat, 0.2M for
        for group in ["TOTAL", "NAT", "FOR"]:
            if group == "TOTAL":
                tot, u15, w64, s65 = 40000000.0, 6000000.0, 25800000.0, 8200000.0
            elif group == "NAT":
                tot, u15, w64, s65 = 35000000.0, 5000000.0, 22000000.0, 8000000.0
            else:
                tot, u15, w64, s65 = 5000000.0, 1000000.0, 3800000.0, 200000.0

            pop_ctz_recs.extend([
                {"time": y, "citizen": group, "age": "TOTAL", "value": tot},
                {"time": y, "citizen": group, "age": "Y_LT15", "value": u15},
                {"time": y, "citizen": group, "age": "Y15-64", "value": w64},
                {"time": y, "citizen": group, "age": "Y_GE65", "value": s65},
            ])
            pop_birth_recs.extend([
                {"time": y, "c_birth": group, "age": "TOTAL", "value": tot},
                {"time": y, "c_birth": group, "age": "Y_LT15", "value": u15},
                {"time": y, "c_birth": group, "age": "Y15-64", "value": w64},
                {"time": y, "c_birth": group, "age": "Y_GE65", "value": s65},
            ])

        # Labor
        emp_ctz_recs.extend([
            {"time": y, "citizen": "TOTAL", "value": 20000.0},
            {"time": y, "citizen": "NAT", "value": 17500.0},
            {"time": y, "citizen": "FOR", "value": 2500.0},
        ])
        emp_birth_recs.extend([
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "TOTAL", "wstatus": "EMP", "value": 20000.0},
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "NAT", "wstatus": "EMP", "value": 17500.0},
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "FOR", "wstatus": "EMP", "value": 2500.0},
        ])

        act_ctz_recs.extend([
            {"time": y, "citizen": "TOTAL", "value": 75.0},
            {"time": y, "citizen": "NAT", "value": 74.0},
            {"time": y, "citizen": "FOR", "value": 78.0},
        ])
        act_birth_recs.extend([
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "TOTAL", "value": 75.0},
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "NAT", "value": 74.0},
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "FOR", "value": 78.0},
        ])

        empr_ctz_recs.extend([
            {"time": y, "citizen": "TOTAL", "value": 65.0},
            {"time": y, "citizen": "NAT", "value": 66.0},
            {"time": y, "citizen": "FOR", "value": 62.0},
        ])
        empr_birth_recs.extend([
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "TOTAL", "value": 65.0},
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "NAT", "value": 66.0},
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "FOR", "value": 62.0},
        ])

        unemp_val_for = 150.0 if (corrupt_unemp and idx == len(years) - 1) else 15.0
        unemp_ctz_recs.extend([
            {"time": y, "citizen": "TOTAL", "value": 12.0},
            {"time": y, "citizen": "NAT", "value": 10.0},
            {"time": y, "citizen": "FOR", "value": unemp_val_for},
        ])
        unemp_birth_recs.extend([
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "TOTAL", "value": 12.0},
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "NAT", "value": 10.0},
            {"time": y, "c_birth": "FOR", "value": unemp_val_for},
        ])

        is_latest_year = (idx == len(years) - 1)
        if not (omit_latest_lag and is_latest_year):
            acq_recs.append({"time": y, "value": 100000.0})

            med_inc = -500.0 if (corrupt_income and is_latest_year) else 14000.0
            inc_ctz_recs.extend([
                {"time": y, "citizen": "NAT", "statinfo": "MED_EI", "value": 20000.0},
                {"time": y, "citizen": "NAT", "statinfo": "MEAN_EI", "value": 22000.0},
                {"time": y, "citizen": "FOR", "statinfo": "MED_EI", "value": med_inc},
                {"time": y, "citizen": "FOR", "statinfo": "MEAN_EI", "value": 16000.0},
            ])
            inc_tot_recs.extend([
                {"time": y, "statinfo": "MED_EI", "value": 19000.0},
                {"time": y, "statinfo": "MEAN_EI", "value": 21000.0},
            ])
            pov_ctz_recs.extend([
                {"time": y, "citizen": "NAT", "value": 15.0},
                {"time": y, "citizen": "FOR", "value": 30.0},
            ])
            pov_tot_recs.append({"time": y, "value": 18.0})

    return {
        "popByCitizenship": EurostatDataset(code="migr_pop1ctz", updated="2026-11-15", records=pop_ctz_recs),
        "popByBirth": EurostatDataset(code="migr_pop3ctb", updated="2026-11-15", records=pop_birth_recs),
        "naturalizations": EurostatDataset(code="migr_acq", updated="2026-11-13", records=acq_recs),
        "employedByCitizenship": EurostatDataset(code="lfsa_egan", updated="2026-10-30", records=emp_ctz_recs),
        "employedByBirth": EurostatDataset(code="lfsa_pgacws", updated="2026-10-30", records=emp_birth_recs),
        "activityRateByCitizenship": EurostatDataset(code="lfsa_argan", updated="2026-10-30", records=act_ctz_recs),
        "activityRateByBirth": EurostatDataset(code="lfsa_argacob", updated="2026-10-30", records=act_birth_recs),
        "employmentRateByCitizenship": EurostatDataset(code="lfsa_ergan", updated="2026-10-30", records=empr_ctz_recs),
        "employmentRateByBirth": EurostatDataset(code="lfsa_ergacob", updated="2026-10-30", records=empr_birth_recs),
        "unemploymentRateByCitizenship": EurostatDataset(code="lfsa_urgan", updated="2026-10-30", records=unemp_ctz_recs),
        "unemploymentRateByBirth": EurostatDataset(code="lfsa_urgacob", updated="2026-10-30", records=unemp_birth_recs),
        "incomeByCitizenship": EurostatDataset(code="ilc_di15", updated="2026-10-26", records=inc_ctz_recs),
        "incomeTotal": EurostatDataset(code="ilc_di03", updated="2026-10-20", records=inc_tot_recs),
        "povertyRateByCitizenship": EurostatDataset(code="ilc_li31", updated="2026-10-20", records=pov_ctz_recs),
        "povertyRateTotal": EurostatDataset(code="ilc_li02", updated="2026-10-20", records=pov_tot_recs),
    }


class TestIndicadoresNacionalidad(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.config = {
            "indicatorId": "indicadores-nacionalidad-espana",
            "category": "Economía y Empleo",
            "question": "¿Cómo se comparan la demografía, el empleo y la renta entre población española y extranjera en España?",
            "chartType": "nationality-indicators",
            "headlineUnit": "% población extranjera",
            "geo": "ES",
            "startYear": 2010,
            "sources": [
                {
                    "datasetKeys": ["popByCitizenship", "popByBirth"],
                    "institution": "INE / Eurostat",
                    "shortName": "Eurostat Demografía",
                    "title": "Población por nacionalidad",
                    "tableId": "migr_pop1ctz",
                    "url": "https://example.com/demo"
                }
            ]
        }
        self.years = [str(y) for y in range(2010, 2021)]  # 11 años

    def test_age_band_share_and_dependency_math(self):
        ds_map = make_mock_datasets(self.years)
        payload = build_nationality_indicators_payload(self.config, ds_map)
        self.assertIn("annualRecords", payload)
        self.assertEqual(len(payload["annualRecords"]), len(self.years))

        rec_latest = payload["annualRecords"][-1]
        demo_for = rec_latest["definitions"]["citizenship"]["demographics"]["foreigners"]

        bands = demo_for["ageBands"]
        sum_pct = bands["under15Pct"] + bands["workingAge15to64Pct"] + bands["senior65plusPct"]
        self.assertAlmostEqual(sum_pct, 100.0, delta=0.5)

        # 200,000 / 3,800,000 * 100 = 5.263 -> round to 1 decimal = 5.3
        self.assertEqual(demo_for["oldAgeDependencyRatio"], 5.3)

        demo_nat = rec_latest["definitions"]["citizenship"]["demographics"]["nationals"]
        # 8,000,000 / 22,000,000 * 100 = 36.36 -> 36.4
        self.assertEqual(demo_nat["oldAgeDependencyRatio"], 36.4)

    def test_representation_shares(self):
        ds_map = make_mock_datasets(self.years)
        payload = build_nationality_indicators_payload(self.config, ds_map)
        rec = payload["annualRecords"][-1]

        demo = rec["definitions"]["citizenship"]["demographics"]
        labor = rec["definitions"]["citizenship"]["laborMarket"]

        # Share of total pop: 5M / 40M * 100 = 12.5%
        self.assertEqual(demo["foreigners"]["shareOfTotalPct"], 12.5)

        # Share of working age pop: 3.8M / 25.8M * 100 = 14.73%
        self.assertEqual(demo["foreigners"]["shareOfWorkingAgePct"], 14.73)

        # Share of employed: 2.5M / 20.0M * 100 = 12.5%
        self.assertEqual(labor["foreigners"]["shareOfEmployedPct"], 12.5)

    def test_partial_latest_year_lag_graceful(self):
        ds_map = make_mock_datasets(self.years, omit_latest_lag=True)
        payload = build_nationality_indicators_payload(self.config, ds_map)

        latest_rec = payload["annualRecords"][-1]
        self.assertIsNone(latest_rec["naturalizations"])
        self.assertIsNone(latest_rec["livingConditions"])

        # Los años previos siguen teniendo datos completos
        prev_rec = payload["annualRecords"][-2]
        self.assertEqual(prev_rec["naturalizations"], 100000)
        self.assertIsNotNone(prev_rec["livingConditions"])

    def test_corrupted_rate_raises(self):
        ds_corrupt_labor = make_mock_datasets(self.years, corrupt_unemp=True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
            build_nationality_indicators_payload(self.config, ds_corrupt_labor)
        self.assertIn("fuera de rango", str(ctx.exception))

        ds_corrupt_inc = make_mock_datasets(self.years, corrupt_income=True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx_inc:
            build_nationality_indicators_payload(self.config, ds_corrupt_inc)
        self.assertIn("Renta corrupta o negativa", str(ctx_inc.exception))

    def test_concept_guide_code_integrity(self):
        guide_path = Path("scrapers/config/indicadores_nacionalidad_guide.json")
        self.assertTrue(guide_path.exists())
        with open(guide_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            guide = json.load(f)

        validate_concept_guide(guide)

        # Verificar que categorías requeridas estén presentes
        cat_ids = {c["id"] for c in guide["categories"]}
        self.assertIn("demographics", cat_ids)
        self.assertIn("labor", cat_ids)
        self.assertIn("income", cat_ids)

        # Verificar términos clave exigidos en la especificación
        term_codes = {t["code"] for t in guide["terms"]}
        for req in [
            "CITIZENSHIP", "BIRTHPLACE", "NATURALIZATION",
            "DEPENDENCY_RATIO", "WORKING_AGE", "ACTIVITY_RATE",
            "EMPLOYMENT_RATE", "UNEMPLOYMENT_RATE", "EQUIVALISED_INCOME",
            "AROP_RATE", "EU_VS_NEU"
        ]:
            self.assertIn(req, term_codes)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

export * from "@/src/domain/indicator.schema";

export const CATEGORIES = [
  "Todas",
  "Vivienda",
  "Economía y Empleo",
  "Sanidad",
  "Pensiones y Demografía",
] as const;

export type Category = (typeof CATEGORIES)[number];

export type Lang = "es" | "en";

export type ChartType =
  | "line"
  | "bar"
  | "fiscal-balance"
  | "immigration-flow"
  | "nationality-indicators";

export type PopulationDefinition = "citizenship" | "birthplace";
export type PopulationGroupKey =
  | "total"
  | "nationals"
  | "foreigners"
  | "euForeigners"
  | "nonEuForeigners";

export interface AgeBandBreakdown {
  under15: number;
  workingAge15to64: number;
  senior65plus: number;
  under15Pct: number;
  workingAge15to64Pct: number;
  senior65plusPct: number;
}

export interface DemographicGroupStats {
  population: number;
  shareOfTotalPct: number;
  shareOfWorkingAgePct: number;
  oldAgeDependencyRatio: number;
  ageBands: AgeBandBreakdown;
}

export interface LaborGroupStats {
  employedThousands: number | null;
  shareOfEmployedPct: number | null;
  activityRatePct: number | null;
  employmentRatePct: number | null;
  unemploymentRatePct: number | null;
}

export interface LivingConditionsGroupStats {
  medianEquivalisedIncomeEur: number | null;
  meanEquivalisedIncomeEur: number | null;
  atRiskOfPovertyPct: number | null;
}

export interface DefinitionYearSlice {
  demographics: Partial<Record<PopulationGroupKey, DemographicGroupStats>> | null;
  laborMarket: Partial<Record<PopulationGroupKey, LaborGroupStats>> | null;
}

export interface NationalityAnnualRecord {
  year: string;
  naturalizations: number | null;
  definitions: Record<PopulationDefinition, DefinitionYearSlice>;
  livingConditions: Partial<Record<PopulationGroupKey, LivingConditionsGroupStats>> | null;
}

export interface DataPoint {
  year: string;
  value: number;
  date?: string;
}

export type MetricSeriesPoint = DataPoint;

export interface SourceInfo {
  institution: string;
  title: string;
  url: string;
  shortName?: string;
  tableId?: string;
  period?: string;
  lastUpdated?: string;
}

export type MetricSource = SourceInfo;

export interface TraceableSource {
  sources?: SourceInfo[];
  source?: SourceInfo;
}

export interface BaseEntityItem {
  id: string;
  category: Category;
  question: string;
  unit: string;
  name?: string;
  state?: string;
}

export interface KeyConceptCard {
  id: string;
  badge: string;
  title: string;
  summary: string;
  example?: string;
}

export interface GlossaryCategory {
  id: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface GlossaryTerm {
  code: string;
  displayCode: string;
  categoryId: string;
  title: string;
  shortDefinition: string;
  explanation: string;
  keyNote?: string;
  relatedCodes?: string[];
}

export interface ConceptGuide {
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  quickKeys: KeyConceptCard[];
  categories: GlossaryCategory[];
  terms: GlossaryTerm[];
}

export interface DatoItem extends BaseEntityItem, TraceableSource {
  chartType: ChartType;
  dataPoints: DataPoint[];
  contextNotes: string[];
  conceptGuide?: ConceptGuide;
  last_updated?: string;
  metrics?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export type CountyDetail = DatoItem;

export interface ItemIndexItem extends BaseEntityItem {
  latestValue: number;
  latestYear: string;
  lastUpdated: string;
  latest_summary?: Record<string, number>;
}

export type CountyIndexItem = ItemIndexItem;

export interface MetricMeta {
  title: string;
  unit: string;
  description?: string;
  source?: MetricSource;
}

export interface GlobalMetadata {
  last_updated: string;
  metrics?: Record<string, MetricMeta>;
  categories?: Category[];
  total_items?: number;
}

// Specific domain types for Immigration series
export interface RegionalBlockData {
  total: number;
  countries: Record<string, number>;
}

export interface AnnualBlock {
  year: string;
  total: number;
  blocks: Record<string, RegionalBlockData>;
}

export interface ImmigrationItem extends TraceableSource {
  id: string;
  category?: Category | string;
  question?: string;
  unit?: string;
  blocks: Array<{
    id: string;
    name: string;
    color: string;
    countries: Array<{ id: string; name: string }>;
  }>;
  annualBlocks: AnnualBlock[];
}

export type FiscalUnitId = "MIO_EUR" | "PC_GDP";

export interface FiscalUnitOption {
  id: FiscalUnitId;
  label: string;
  decimals?: number;
}

export interface FiscalTaxonomyChild {
  code: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface FiscalRevenueTaxon {
  code: string;
  label: string;
  shortLabel: string;
  derivedFormula?: string;
  children: FiscalTaxonomyChild[];
}

export interface FiscalExpenditureTaxon {
  code: string;
  label: string;
  shortLabel: string;
  highlights: FiscalTaxonomyChild[];
}

export interface FiscalTaxonomy {
  revenues: FiscalRevenueTaxon[];
  expenditures: FiscalExpenditureTaxon[];
}

export interface FiscalTotals {
  revenue: number;
  expenditure: number;
  balance: number;
  uncollectibleAdjustment?: number;
}

export interface FiscalRevenueEntry {
  total: number;
  breakdown: Record<string, number>;
}

export interface FiscalExpenditureEntry {
  total: number;
  highlights: Record<string, number>;
}

export interface FiscalUnitMetrics {
  totals: FiscalTotals;
  revenues: Record<string, FiscalRevenueEntry>;
  expenditures: Record<string, FiscalExpenditureEntry> | null;
}

export interface AnnualBalanceRecord {
  year: string;
  cofogAvailable: boolean;
  metrics: Record<FiscalUnitId, FiscalUnitMetrics>;
}

export interface FiscalBalanceItem extends DatoItem {
  chartType: "fiscal-balance";
  availableUnits: FiscalUnitOption[];
  taxonomy: FiscalTaxonomy;
  annualBalances: AnnualBalanceRecord[];
}

export function isFiscalBalanceItem(item: DatoItem): item is FiscalBalanceItem {
  return (
    item.chartType === "fiscal-balance" &&
    "annualBalances" in item &&
    Array.isArray((item as Partial<FiscalBalanceItem>).annualBalances)
  );
}

export interface NationalityIndicatorsItem extends DatoItem {
  chartType: "nationality-indicators";
  annualRecords: NationalityAnnualRecord[];
}

export function isNationalityIndicatorsItem(
  item: DatoItem
): item is NationalityIndicatorsItem {
  return (
    item.chartType === "nationality-indicators" &&
    "annualRecords" in item &&
    Array.isArray((item as Partial<NationalityIndicatorsItem>).annualRecords)
  );
}
